title: AI Analyst
description:
**About the Company**

ED&F Man Commodities is a global commodities business with operations across agricultural products and supply chains. This position will sit within the Cotton business, supporting teams across the cotton value chain. The successful candidate will work with colleagues across commercial, operational, financial and analytical functions to identify opportunities where AI and automation can improve efficiency, access to information and decision making.

**About the Role**

AI Enablement Analyst – Cotton

Role Overview

We have an exciting opportunity for someone to join ED&F Man as an AI Enablement Analyst within the Cotton business, working in a truly global environment. The role will work closely with colleagues across Trading, Operations, Finance and Research, helping to bridge the gap between business teams and technology. The primary focus will be on understanding how the Cotton business operates, identifying inefficient or manual processes, and determining where AI, automation and data driven tools can improve the way teams work. The AI Enablement Analyst will translate business requirements into practical AI solutions, develop and test new workflows using our in house AI platform, and support employees in embedding these tools into their day to day activities. This is a business facing role rather than a traditional software engineering position. Success will come from understanding processes, identifying valuable use cases, experimenting quickly and helping users adopt solutions that deliver measurable improvements. The role provides long term development potential for someone looking to combine AI, technology and process improvement within the physical commodities industry.

**Responsibilities**

* Work across the Cotton business, including Trading, Operations, Finance and Research, to understand existing workflows, data requirements, pain points and decision making processes.
* Identify manual, repetitive or inefficient processes and assess whether they can be improved through AI, automation or existing technology solutions.
* Translate business requirements into clear AI use cases, prompts, agent workflows and tool integrations on our in house AI platform.
* Build, test and refine lightweight AI solutions, including prompt templates, AI agents, Retrieval Augmented Generation workflows and prototypes, before partnering with technology teams where further engineering is required.
* Map business processes and document requirements, user journeys and expected outcomes to ensure solutions address genuine business problems.

* Develop AI solutions supporting areas such as:

* Information retrieval and natural language Q&A
* Research synthesis and document analysis
* Operational workflow automation
* Management information and reporting
* Data extraction and reconciliation
* Contract and documentation workflows
* Internal knowledge management
* Finance and operational analysis
* Business summaries and recurring reporting

* Develop and maintain prompt libraries, agent playbooks, evaluation datasets and quality measures to ensure solutions are repeatable and reliable.
* Test AI workflows systematically, identifying errors and weaknesses and improving prompts, workflows and controls.
* Partner with Technology, Data, Risk and Compliance teams to ensure AI solutions are secure, controlled and appropriate for production use.
* Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams, translating operational challenges into practical technical requirements.
* Drive adoption of AI across the Cotton business through demonstrations, training sessions, user support and continuous feedback.
* Develop practical training materials, guides and examples that help employees understand how AI can be incorporated into their day to day work.
* Track adoption and outcomes to ensure AI initiatives are delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, quality or decision making.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Teams across Cotton regularly use AI tools to improve everyday business processes.
* Manual and repetitive workflows are identified and progressively automated or simplified.
* AI solutions solve clearly defined business problems rather than becoming isolated experiments.
* Prompts and workflows are robust, repeatable and measurable.
* Employees understand how to use AI effectively and adoption increases across different functions.
* Business users see you as someone who understands their problems and can translate them into practical solutions.
* Technology teams receive clearly defined requirements and well tested prototypes when more sophisticated engineering is required.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Finance or a related discipline.

**Required Skills**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in a technical, analytical, automation or technology enabled business role.
* Hands on experience working with LLMs and generative AI, including prompt design, structured prompting and building repeatable AI workflows.
* Experience designing or configuring AI agents, agentic workflows or tool based automations.
* Understanding of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and how AI applications can use internal documents, data or knowledge sources.
* Experience testing and evaluating AI outputs, including prompt iteration, error analysis, guardrails and quality evaluation.
* Ability to build and test lightweight prototypes before handing more complex solutions to engineering teams.
* Python or scripting experience for prototyping, automation or data analysis.
* Strong ability to understand business processes and translate requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders across Trading, Operations, Finance and Research.

**Preferred Skills**

* Previous experience within commodities, physical supply chains, logistics or trading related environments.
* Experience with business process mapping, requirements gathering or user stories.

**Our Commitment**

We are committed to creating and sustaining an inclusive and diverse work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. We are committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment and are focussed on actively building and developing diverse teams. All qualified applicants will receive equal treatment without regard to race, colour, sex, gender, age, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, marital or civil partner status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender reassignment (identity, gender expression), genetic information or any characteristic protected by local law. We are willing to make any reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process. To apply, you must have the right to work in the location where the role is based

title: Document Controller
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – DOCUMENT CONTROLLER

**Experience:**
7–10 Years

**Industry:**
High-Rise BuildingConstruction / PMC / EPC

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Qualification:**
Graduate in any discipline; candidates with a technical or engineering background will be preferred.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Document Controller to manage, coordinate, track, and maintain project documentation for a high-rise building construction project. The candidate will be responsible for controlling design documents, drawings, technical submissions, material submittals, method statements, RFIs, and other project-related correspondence, ensuring proper document flow, revision control, timely distribution, and compliance with project documentation procedures.

Key Responsibilities

1. Design Documentation Management

* Manage and maintain all design-related documents, including architectural, structural, MEP, and other engineering drawings.
* Maintain drawing registers, revision histories, transmittals, and document distribution records.
* Ensure the latest approved drawings and documents are available to the relevant project teamsand site personnel.
* Track drawing submissions, reviews, comments, revisions, and approvals from consultants, designers, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate the circulation of revised drawingsand ensure superseded versions are withdrawn from active use.

1. Technical Submissions and Approval Tracking

* Maintain and monitor technical submittals, including material submissions, technical data sheets, product catalogues, method statements, shop drawings, and technical specifications.
* Track submissions, review comments, resubmissions, approvals, and pending actions.

* Coordinate with design consultants, PMC, contractors, subcontractors, and internal engineering teams to ensure timely processing of technical documents.
* Maintain registers for RFIs, technical queries, design clarifications, inspection requests, and other technical correspondence, as applicable.
* Follow up with concerned stakeholders to resolve pending reviews and approvals within the required timelines.

1. Document Control and RecordsManagement

* Establish and maintain a systematic document control system for all project documentation.
* Maintain incoming and outgoing documentregisters, correspondence logs,drawing registers, technical submittal logs, and approval trackers.
* Ensure correct documentnumbering, coding, naming conventions, revisionidentification, and status classification.
* Maintain soft and hard copies of documents in an organized, easily retrievable manner.
* Ensure proper versioncontrol, traceability, confidentiality, and controlled accessto project records.

1. Project Coordination and Reporting

* Coordinate with design, planning, construction, QA/QC, MEP, contracts, and commercial teams for document circulation and follow-up.
* Prepare periodic reports on pending submissions, overdue approvals, outstanding RFIs, and drawing status.
* Highlight delays in document approvals that may affectconstruction progress.
* Support project meetings by preparing document status reports and maintaining records of technical correspondence and action items.

1. Digital Document Management and Handover

* Ensure documents are uploaded, indexed, categorized, and maintained according to projectprocedures.
* Support the preparation and compilation of as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, test certificates, and final handover documentation.
* Maintain proper archival records and ensure smooth document retrieval during audits and project closeout.

title: SPE-Reg Affairs-Med Writing
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role of Senior Professional Regulatory Affairs and Medical Writing focuses on preparing high quality regulatory documents and product submissions that comply with global life sciences standards and internal policies while supporting research and development teams. The candidate will apply regulatory domain expertise to transform complex scientific and business information into clear documentation that enables timely approvals supports patient safety and advances the company mission
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with regulatory affairs and research and development teams to prepare comprehensive regulatory reports that clearly communicate product safety efficacy and quality data for timely submission to global authorities.
* Develop structured regulatory documentation by transforming complex scientific findings and business requirements into accurate concise and compliant narratives that support product registrations and lifecycle management.
* Coordinate regulatory product specialist activities by aligning documentation content with evolving product strategies indications and risk profiles to ensure consistent messaging across all submissions.
* Conduct detailed regulatory domain analysis to interpret guidelines policies and standards and translate them into practical documentation plans and templates that streamline reporting activities.
* Perform regulatory business analysis by mapping business processes timelines and data dependencies to create clear documentation workflows that reduce rework and support audit readiness.
* Implement regulatory and standards compliance practices throughout medical writing tasks by applying relevant laws industry standards and internal procedures to minimize compliance risks.
* Engage with life sciences regulatory stakeholders to gather source information verify data integrity and resolve content gaps ensuring that all written deliverables reflect accurate and current scientific evidence.
* Prepare high quality clinical and nonclinical summaries risk management sections and justification narratives that demonstrate product benefit risk profiles and support regulatory decision making.
* Maintain robust documentation control and version tracking for regulatory submissions by organizing files references and supporting data in structured repositories that enable efficient review and inspection.
* Support hybrid work model collaboration by using digital tools and secure platforms to manage document reviews track comments and maintain transparency among cross functional contributors.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of regulatory business process services by recommending enhancements to templates checklists and workflows that increase efficiency and consistency in medical writing output.
* Ensure day shift availability for cross functional meetings and real time collaboration enabling responsive support to regulatory teams without requiring travel commitments.
* Advance company purpose and societal impact by producing clear and trustworthy regulatory documentation that facilitates safe and effective healthcare solutions reaching patients and communities.

**Qualifications**

* Apply foundational experience in regulatory reporting to design and deliver submission ready documents that meet authority expectations and internal quality benchmarks.
* Utilize regulatory product specialist knowledge to align written content with product claims target markets and risk management strategies in a descriptive and well structured manner.
* Leverage strong regulatory domain knowledge to interpret complex guidance documents and convert them into practical writing approaches that reduce ambiguity and enhance compliance.
* Use regulatory business analyst skills to assess information flows data sources and stakeholder needs producing documentation that supports informed regulatory and business decisions.
* Demonstrate expertise in regulatory and standards compliance by consistently integrating applicable frameworks into medical writing activities thereby reducing rejection rates and queries.
* Apply life sciences regulatory experience to ensure that documentation reflects industry best practices scientific rigor and ethical considerations in research communication.
* Draw on background in regulatory business process services to support streamlined document preparation review and approval cycles that fit organizational governance models.
* Employ regulatory affairs knowledge to create submission packages that address authority expectations cover all required modules and respond effectively to potential questions.
* Use research and development exposure to understand study designs endpoints and methodologies enabling accurate description of evidence in regulatory documents.
* Demonstrate fluent English language skills native level read write speak to produce precise clear and easily understood regulatory narratives and correspondence.
* Adapt experience level between one and four years to handle progressively complex documentation tasks while remaining open to mentoring feedback and structured skill development.
* Show commitment to hybrid work practices by effectively managing time communication and documentation tasks across onsite and remote settings while maintaining confidentiality and data security.

**Certifications Required**
Regulatory Affairs Certification RAC or equivalent credential in life sciences regulatory or medical writing

title: Product Solution Engineer
description:
**About Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC)**

Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC) is a Section 8 company, incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013. It is promoted by the State Bank of India (SBI) and Bank of Baroda, along with other banks/payment companies, and functions under the regulatory approval and oversight of the Department of Financial Services and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). IDPIC has been established as the nation’s central digital payment fraud intelligence platform. Its primary mandate is to detect, prevent, and analyse fraud in India’s rapidly expanding digital payments ecosystem in real time. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Big Data Analytics, IDPIC plays a pivotal role in strengthening the security and trustworthiness of India’s digital payment infrastructure.

**Position Overview:**

Responsible for System implementation, solution consulting , tech integrations and successful enablement of participating banks on the DPIP platform and support to the Bank edge setup.

 The role will act as the primary technical interface between IDPIC, participating banks and the engineering teams, driving end-to-end implementation, solution consulting, integration support, testing, certification and production rollout while identifying implementation-driven enhancements required for the DPIP platform.

**Qualification and Eligibility Criteria:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, Engineering, M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc. (Computer Science/IT) or a related discipline.

Relevant certifications in cloud, cybersecurity, data analytics, APIs, or software technologies will be an added advantage.

**Work Experience:**

Freshers as well as candidates with experience in system implementation, solution consulting and tech integrations

Basic knowledge of software development and system architecture.

Understanding of REST APIs, JSON/XML and API testing.

Basic knowledge of databases and SQL.

Familiarity with cloud computing concepts.

Understanding of networking and cybersecurity fundamentals.

Basic knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Familiarity with Git/version control and development tools.

Good analytical and troubleshooting skills. Good documentation and presentation skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Bank Onboarding & Enablement: Manage end-to-end onboarding of participating banks onto the DPIP platform, including understanding their fraud management, integration, and operational ecosystem.
2. Solution Consulting & Requirements Analysis: Analyse bank-specific business and technical requirements and map them to DPIP capabilities, identifying integration approaches and implementation requirements.
3. Product Enhancement & Gap Identification: Identify implementation gaps, enhancement requirements, and product improvements arising from bank onboarding and integration activities.
4. Testing, Certification & Production Readiness: Coordinate functional testing, integration testing, UAT, certification, deployment readiness, and production go-live activities for participating banks.
5. Implementation Tracking & Post-Go-Live Support: Track milestones, deliverables, and implementation progress, and provide post-go-live/hypercare support to ensure smooth adoption and resolution of issues.

title: Technical Service & Development Specialist
company: E. O. C. Tailormade Polymers I Private Limited
description:
/ Technical Service & Development Specialist België - Evergem Solliciteer nu

EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground.

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

**What will you do?**

* You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
* You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
* Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
* You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
* You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
* You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
* You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.
* You contribute to the wider growth ambition of the Exomelt business as part of a small, fast-moving startup team.

**Who are you?**

* You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
* You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
* You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
* You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
* You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
* You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
* You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.
* You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

**What do we offer?**
You get the opportunity to help build and shape a growing hotmelt adhesives business from a hands-on, technical business development seat. You will have direct exposure to customers, specialists and leadership within a focused startup team, backed by EOC Group's broader resources and specialty chemicals expertise. It is a varied role combining technical problem-solving, customer-facing business development, and industry visibility through conferences and trade shows. In addition, we offer an attractive salary package with additional benefits, including a company car.

title: Product Building & Curriculum Lead – STEM
description:
**Company Description**
OLL.co is a fast-growing practical learning platform focused on creating a billion daily active learners by going beyond traditional education. Educators with OLL.co teach over 20,000 learners daily across India through schools and online programs in multiple countries. The organization offers hands-on learning in more than 100 future-ready skills, including AI, robotics, coding, entrepreneurship, and financial literacy. OLL.co also runs “Skill Tank,” a TV show on CNBC TV18 that showcases student business ideas, and leads the Skill Bharat Association, a network of school leaders driving skill development nationwide. The Product Building & Curriculum Lead – STEM is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai. Day-to-day tasks include developing structured STEM modules and lesson plans, creating engaging activities and projects in areas such as robotics, coding, and AI, and collaborating with educators and product teams to ensure content quality and learner outcomes. The Lead will gather feedback from learners, teachers, and school partners to refine curriculum, maintain alignment with educational standards and industry trends, and support pilot implementations and training for educators. The role also involves documenting best practices, preparing learning resources and assessments, and contributing to new program launches across schools and online platforms.

* Demonstrated curriculum design and instructional design skills, including creating lesson plans, learning activities, and assessments.

* Comfort working on-site in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment in Mumbai, with a learner-centric and experiment-driven mindset.

title: Senior SEO Content Writer
description:
As the Senior SEO Content Writer at IIDE, Mumbai, you will play a key role in creating high-quality, search-optimised content that strengthens IIDE’s organic visibility, engages prospective learners, and contributes to lead generation.

This role involves researching, writing, editing, and optimising content across blogs, landing pages, website pages, reports, case studies, PR articles, guest posts, and other marketing formats. You will work closely with the SEO and Growth teams to translate keyword opportunities and search intent into valuable content while maintaining IIDE’s brand voice and editorial standards.

You will also support junior writers and interns through content reviews and feedback while continuously improving content performance, quality, and conversion potential.

**What You’ll Do:**

**SEO Content Creation & Optimisation:**

* Research and create well-structured, engaging, and SEO-optimised blogs, website pages, landing pages, PR articles, guest posts, reports, case studies, and marketing content.
* Write content that effectively addresses search intent while maintaining readability, accuracy, relevance, and IIDE’s brand voice.
* Optimise existing website and blog content to improve organic rankings, traffic, engagement, and lead conversion.
* Incorporate keywords, internal links, headings, metadata recommendations, calls-to-action, and other on-page SEO elements naturally within content.

**Research & Content Quality:**

* Conduct in-depth research across education, careers, digital marketing, business, AI, emerging technologies, and related topics.
* Ensure content is factual, credible, original, and aligned with Google’s Helpful Content and E-E-A-T principles.
* Edit and proofread content for grammar, clarity, structure, consistency, tone, and factual accuracy.
* Translate complex topics into simple, useful, and engaging content for different learner audiences.

**SEO & Growth Collaboration:**

* Work closely with the SEO team to understand keyword opportunities, search intent, content gaps, competitor insights, and organic growth priorities.
* Collaborate with the Growth team to create content that supports both traffic acquisition and lead-generation objectives.
* Review content performance and use SEO and analytics insights to identify opportunities for updates, refreshes, and optimisation.
* Develop conversion-focused website content and improve calls-to-action, messaging, and content flow to support higher lead conversion rates.

**Content Editing & Writer Support:**

* Review content created by junior writers and interns and provide actionable feedback to improve quality, structure, SEO alignment, and readability.
* Support the creation of content briefs, outlines, and research directions for assigned topics.
* Help maintain consistent editorial standards and brand communication across published content.
* Share content writing and SEO best practices with junior members of the content team.

**AI-Assisted Content Development:**

* Use AI tools responsibly for research, ideation, content outlining, brainstorming, and productivity enhancement.
* Fact-check, edit, and human-review all AI-assisted outputs before using them in published content.
* Experiment with new tools and workflows that improve content quality and efficiency without compromising originality or credibility.

**Additional Duties:**

* Stay updated with SEO trends, Google search updates, content marketing practices, and developments in AI-assisted content creation.
* Contribute ideas for new content formats, topics, reports, and organic growth initiatives.
* Coordinate with designers, SEO specialists, marketers, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth content execution.
* Perform any other reasonable duties as requested by management, aligned with the broad scope of the position.

Requirements

**Who You Are:**

**Must-Have:**

* 2 to 4 years of professional content writing, SEO content writing, or editorial experience.
* Excellent written English with strong research, writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Proven ability to create long-form and short-form content across blogs, websites, landing pages, articles, and marketing formats.
* Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals, including keywords, search intent, internal linking, content optimisation, and on-page SEO.
* Ability to research unfamiliar topics and convert complex information into clear, engaging, and useful content.
* Experience reviewing content and providing constructive feedback to junior writers or interns.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.

**Should Have:**

* Understanding of Google’s Helpful Content principles and E-E-A-T guidelines.
* Experience writing content designed to drive organic traffic, engagement, and conversions.
* Familiarity with content performance metrics and the ability to use performance insights to improve existing content.
* Experience working closely with SEO, marketing, or growth teams.
* Comfortable using AI tools for research, ideation, and content workflows while maintaining strong editorial judgement.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in education, EdTech, digital marketing, business, AI, careers, or another content-led industry.
* Familiarity with SEO and analytics tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console.
* Experience working with CMS platforms such as WordPress or Strapi.
* Familiarity with tools and workflows for content optimisation, competitor research, and AI-assisted content creation.

**Why Join IIDE?**

* Work with one of India’s fastest-growing digital education brands.
* Create high-impact content across digital marketing, business, careers, education, and AI.
* Gain hands-on exposure to SEO, organic growth, conversion optimisation, and content strategy.
* Work closely with SEO and Growth teams and see the measurable impact of your content.
* Build expertise across multiple formats, from search-led blogs to conversion-focused website content.
* Be part of a collaborative, high-growth environment where strong ideas and ownership are valued.

**Who You’ll Thrive As**

You’re someone who:

* Enjoys turning research and complex information into content that is clear, engaging, and genuinely useful.
* Thinks about both the reader and search intent while creating content.
* Has a sharp editorial eye and notices gaps in grammar, structure, logic, tone, and accuracy.
* Is curious about SEO, digital marketing, AI, education, business, and changing search behaviour.
* Uses AI as a productivity tool without compromising originality, accuracy, or human judgement.
* Takes ownership of your work and is comfortable managing multiple content pieces and deadlines.
* Enjoys helping junior writers improve while remaining hands-on with writing and editing.
* Understands that great SEO content should not only rank but also educate, engage, and drive meaningful action.

title: Application Executive
description:
**Application Executive**

**Location:**
Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**About the Company**

Metal Power provides a comprehensive range of products and services to meet the analytical needs of metal industries. Our product portfolio spans Laboratory Optical / Atomic Emission Spectrometers (OES / AES), Mobile Spectrometers, Hydrogen analyzers for molten Aluminium, Certified Reference Materials (CRM), Sample Preparation Machines for spectrometers as well as a wide range of accessories. Apart from the product range, Metal Power through its Laboratory Division also offers services in Material Analyses and Proficiency Testing for other laboratories. Today the Company boasts over 25 years of experience serving the needs of ferrous and non-ferrous metals industries and has a presence across more than 30 countries globally.

Metal Power is the only Optical Emission Spectrometer manufacturing company in the world that provides complete end-to-end solutions for metal industries through our range of products - across spectrometers, associated equipment and accessories.

Our in-house Chemical and Analytical Research Laboratory and highly successful line of Certified Reference Materials (CRM) have helped us maintain our leadership and growth. Our Laboratory is NABL-accredited for both Chemical and Proficiency Testing. We are also the first accredited solid metal Certified Reference Material Producers in India and all of Asia.

**About the Role**

The Application Executive develops, validates, and optimizes analytical applications and product enhancements for analytical instruments. The role owns application performance, repeatability, reproducibility, validation, and process standardization through structured testing and quality evaluation. It investigates application-related issues, supports root cause analysis and corrective actions, and validates new product features and upgrades against functional, quality, and customer requirements. The role also develops and maintains SOPs, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports, application documents, and testing records. Working with Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management teams, the incumbent supports product evaluations, troubleshooting, customer demonstrations, internal technical training, and continuous product improvement. Success is measured through improved product quality, analytical accuracy, reliability, process effectiveness, documentation control, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate and optimize product components and application methods through structured testing to improve analytical performance, precision, repeatability, reproducibility, and ease of use.
* Identify product improvement opportunities using testing results, customer feedback, and internal quality data, then support corrective actions and measurable performance enhancements.
* Investigate application-related issues and contribute to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and validation activities that restore reliable product performance.
* Conduct repeatability and reproducibility studies, optimize analytical parameters, and analyze quality data to improve measurement accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Support new product development, product upgrades, prototype evaluation, and application feature validation to ensure functional, quality, and customer requirements are met before release.
* Develop, validate, and standardize application and calibration processes while driving continuous improvement in product quality, operational efficiency, and process effectiveness.
* Prepare and maintain controlled SOPs, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports, application documents, testing records, and process improvement records for relevant stakeholders.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Analytical application development and optimization for analytical instruments, including analytical parameter optimization, application methods, and calibration processes.
* Product validation, repeatability and reproducibility studies, structured testing, performance evaluation, and quality data analysis.
* Application-related troubleshooting, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and validation of product improvements against defined standards.
* Technical documentation, including SOPs, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports, application documents, and controlled testing records.
* Cross-functional collaboration with Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management teams.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience supporting new product development, product upgrades, prototype evaluation, or application feature validation.
* Experience providing technical support during product evaluations, troubleshooting, customer demonstrations, or internal technical training.
* Familiarity with quality standards, operational procedures, corrective and preventive improvements, and documentation control.

**What You'll Bring**

* A Master of Science in Physics or Master of Science in Analytical Chemistry, with 1–3 years of relevant experience in analytical applications, product validation, application methods, or analytical instruments.
* The ability to develop, validate, and optimize application methods and product components through structured testing, performance evaluation, and quality data analysis.
* Practical capability in conducting repeatability and reproducibility studies, improving analytical parameters, and supporting measurement accuracy, product consistency, and reliable performance.
* Experience investigating application-related issues and contributing to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and validation of product improvements against defined quality and performance standards.
* The ability to support new product development, product enhancements, prototype evaluation, and feature validation against functional, quality, and customer requirements.
* Strong documentation skills for preparing and maintaining SOPs, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports, application documents, and testing records.
* A collaborative working style for partnering with Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management teams on product development, issue resolution, technical support, and continuous improvement.
* The ability to share application knowledge and best practices through technical training while maintaining compliance with internal quality standards and applicable industry requirements.

**Why Join Us**

* Work on analytical applications and product enhancements that improve product quality, analytical reliability, repeatability, reproducibility, and ease of use.
* Collaborate with Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management teams on product development, issue resolution, validation, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to technical documentation, application standardization, product upgrades, and improvements in operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to contribute to analytical instrument product quality, application development, validation, standardization, and continuous improvement.
* Cross-functional exposure to Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management activities through product development and issue resolution.

title: Field Engineer - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
  
  
****About The Role****
We’re hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you’ll be the technical face of Anysphere in the field, helping customers evaluate Cursor, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows.
  
  
You’ll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer-facing role where you’ll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Partner with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements
* Build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, architects, and developers, serving as their technical advisor
* Translate customer requirements into solution designs, guiding them on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, and context configuration
* Develop and deliver technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, and hands-on workshops tailored to customer needs
* Act as the customer’s technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering
* Collaborate with post-sales teams to ensure a smooth handoff and successful customer onboarding
* Maintain deep knowledge of Cursor’s capabilities and competitive landscape to position our value effectively
* Support strategic account planning and help drive expansion opportunities with technical validation

**You may be a fit if**

* You have strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs.
* You have a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, modern engineering org structures, and developer productivity challenges
* You have hands-on technical ability, and while you don’t need to be a full-time engineer, but you should be fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and debugging complex environments
* You are customer-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact
* You have experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software
* You thrive in a startup environment: resourceful, adaptable, and proactive in creating solutions

title: Application Executive
description:
**Application Executive**

**Location:**
Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**About the Company**

Metal Power provides a comprehensive range of products and services to meet the analytical needs of metal industries. Our product portfolio spans Laboratory Optical / Atomic Emission Spectrometers (OES / AES), Mobile Spectrometers, Hydrogen analyzers for molten Aluminium, Certified Reference Materials (CRM), Sample Preparation Machines for spectrometers as well as a wide range of accessories. Apart from the product range, Metal Power through its Laboratory Division also offers services in Material Analyses and Proficiency Testing for other laboratories. Today the Company boasts over 25 years of experience serving the needs of ferrous and non-ferrous metals industries and has a presence across more than 30 countries globally.

Metal Power is the only Optical Emission Spectrometer manufacturing company in the world that provides complete end-to-end solutions for metal industries through our range of products - across spectrometers, associated equipment and accessories.

Our in-house Chemical and Analytical Research Laboratory and highly successful line of Certified Reference Materials (CRM) have helped us maintain our leadership and growth. Our Laboratory is NABL-accredited for both Chemical and Proficiency Testing. We are also the first accredited solid metal Certified Reference Material Producers in India and all of Asia.

**About the Role**

The Application Executive develops, validates, and optimizes analytical applications and product enhancements for analytical instruments. The role owns application performance, repeatability, reproducibility, validation, and process standardization through structured testing and quality evaluation. It investigates application-related issues, supports root cause analysis and corrective actions, and validates new product features and upgrades against functional, quality, and customer requirements. The role also develops and maintains SOPs, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports, application documents, and testing records. Working with Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management teams, the incumbent supports product evaluations, troubleshooting, customer demonstrations, internal technical training, and continuous product improvement. Success is measured through improved product quality, analytical accuracy, reliability, process effectiveness, documentation control, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate and optimize product components and application methods through structured testing to improve analytical performance, precision, repeatability, reproducibility, and ease of use.
* Identify product improvement opportunities using testing results, customer feedback, and internal quality data, then support corrective actions and measurable performance enhancements.
* Investigate application-related issues and contribute to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and validation activities that restore reliable product performance.
* Conduct repeatability and reproducibility studies, optimize analytical parameters, and analyze quality data to improve measurement accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Support new product development, product upgrades, prototype evaluation, and application feature validation to ensure functional, quality, and customer requirements are met before release.
* Develop, validate, and standardize application and calibration processes while driving continuous improvement in product quality, operational efficiency, and process effectiveness.
* Prepare and maintain controlled SOPs, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports, application documents, testing records, and process improvement records for relevant stakeholders.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Analytical application development and optimization for analytical instruments, including analytical parameter optimization, application methods, and calibration processes.
* Product validation, repeatability and reproducibility studies, structured testing, performance evaluation, and quality data analysis.
* Application-related troubleshooting, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and validation of product improvements against defined standards.
* Technical documentation, including SOPs, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports, application documents, and controlled testing records.
* Cross-functional collaboration with Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management teams.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience supporting new product development, product upgrades, prototype evaluation, or application feature validation.
* Experience providing technical support during product evaluations, troubleshooting, customer demonstrations, or internal technical training.
* Familiarity with quality standards, operational procedures, corrective and preventive improvements, and documentation control.

**What You'll Bring**

* A Master of Science in Physics or Master of Science in Analytical Chemistry, with 1–3 years of relevant experience in analytical applications, product validation, application methods, or analytical instruments.
* The ability to develop, validate, and optimize application methods and product components through structured testing, performance evaluation, and quality data analysis.
* Practical capability in conducting repeatability and reproducibility studies, improving analytical parameters, and supporting measurement accuracy, product consistency, and reliable performance.
* Experience investigating application-related issues and contributing to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and validation of product improvements against defined quality and performance standards.
* The ability to support new product development, product enhancements, prototype evaluation, and feature validation against functional, quality, and customer requirements.
* Strong documentation skills for preparing and maintaining SOPs, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports, application documents, and testing records.
* A collaborative working style for partnering with Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management teams on product development, issue resolution, technical support, and continuous improvement.
* The ability to share application knowledge and best practices through technical training while maintaining compliance with internal quality standards and applicable industry requirements.

**Why Join Us**

* Work on analytical applications and product enhancements that improve product quality, analytical reliability, repeatability, reproducibility, and ease of use.
* Collaborate with Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management teams on product development, issue resolution, validation, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to technical documentation, application standardization, product upgrades, and improvements in operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to contribute to analytical instrument product quality, application development, validation, standardization, and continuous improvement.
* Cross-functional exposure to Research & Development, Quality, Production, Service, and Product Management activities through product development and issue resolution.

title: Technical Support Engineer II
description:
Repligen is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Technical Support Engineer II to join our dedicated Service team. This role is responsible for providing technical support to customers, field service engineers, commercial teams, and internal stakeholders using Repligen bioprocessing products and technologies.
  
  
As a Technical Support Engineer II, you will help ensure customer success by responding to technical inquiries, supporting troubleshooting activities, documenting customer issues, and collaborating with internal teams to drive cases toward resolution. This position is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation, excellent communication skills, and an interest in developing expertise in bioprocessing equipment, service support, and customer-facing technical problem solving.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Support:**
Provide timely and effective technical support to customers and Repligen team members via phone, email, video conferencing, and other communication channels. Support troubleshooting of product hardware, software, process, and system-related inquiries.
  
  
Product Knowledge: Develop and maintain a strong working knowledge of Repligen’s product portfolio, bioprocessing applications, system components, operating software, and related technologies.
  
  
**Customer Engagement:**
Communicate professionally with customers and internal stakeholders to understand reported issues, gather necessary information, provide updates, and support a positive customer experience.
  
  
**Troubleshooting and Problem Solving**
: Assist in analyzing and diagnosing technical issues, identifying possible causes, recommending next steps, and guiding customers or internal teams through the resolution process.
  
  
**Case Management and Documentation:**
Manage support cases using Salesforce to document customer inquiries, troubleshooting steps, technical findings, communications, and resolution details. Ensure case records are accurate, complete, and maintained in accordance with internal procedures.
  
  
**Technical Documentation:**
Assist in creating, reviewing, and updating technical documentation, including troubleshooting guides, FAQs, technical notes, work instructions, manuals, and internal knowledge articles.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
Work closely with Technical Support, Field Service, Service Scheduling, Product Management, Engineering, Quality, Sales, and other internal teams to support customer issue resolution and communicate product feedback.
  
  
**Service Coordination:**
Support coordination of follow-up activities, including replacement part requests, RMA support, field service dispatch requests, and escalation of unresolved or complex technical issues.
  
  
**Training and Development:**
Participate in product training, technical workshops, and internal knowledge-sharing activities to build technical proficiency and improve customer support capability.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Identify recurring customer issues, documentation gaps, support process improvements, and opportunities to improve the customer and field service support experience.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree and or equivalent related experience in a relevant field (e.g., Bioengineering, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Life Sciences or Engineering related).
* A minimum of 3 years of experience supporting bioprocessing equipment, biopharmaceutical manufacturing operations, process development, applications, technical support, field service, or related life sciences activities.
* Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues using a structured and logical approach.
* Experience with or knowledge of tangential flow filtration (TFF), automation platforms, and related life sciences technologies is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with Repligen's Systems portfolio including KrosFlo KR2i, KMPi, RS Systems, FS15, FS500, and related filtration and process control technologies is preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, strong verbal/written communications skills and attention to detail are required.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM/service management systems to manage customer support activities.
* Experience with creating and updating technical documentation (Protocols, manuals, SOPs, work instructions, etc.)
* Experience installing, configuring, troubleshooting, or supporting software applications associated with bioprocessing equipment and automated manufacturing systems is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to interpret software alarms, system diagnostics, event logs, communication errors, and equipment-generated data to support technical investigations and issue resolution.
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals, Windows operating systems, software deployment, and remote support tools is beneficial.
* Familiarity with, or proficiency in, GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, and other life sciences related regulations is highly beneficial.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work well within a global, cross functional team.
* Ability to prioritize and work independently to achieve defined goals.
* Must be fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven experience supporting customers throughout Asia-Pacific markets.
* Additional proficiency in Japanese, Mandarin Chinese, or Korean is considered an advantage.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for customer site visits and training.

* Root cause analysis, failure investigation, and technical problem-solving.
* Proficiency in Creo (or equivalent 3D CAD software) and PLM systems.
* Knowledge of DFM, DFA, DFMEA, stress analysis, and FEA.
* Understanding of API, ISO, and Oil & Gas engineering standards.

* Technical leadership or mentoring experience is an added advantage.

description:

title: Manager – Transformation Office
description:
Manager – Transformation Office

We are building a Transformation Office to drive a portfolio of operational, digital, capital and people projects across our sites. We need someone to make that portfolio run with discipline: clear scope, honest status, visible risks and decisions made at the right level.

THE ROLE

- Reports to: Chief Transformation Officer

- Base: Mumbai, with around 20% travel to our sites and supplier or technology partners (more during project launches)

- Scope: individual contributor or small-team role, with authority to coordinate projects across functions. Department heads keep line authority; you keep the portfolio honest.

You will give the CTO and project sponsors a current, evidence-based view of scope, milestones, risks, decisions, resources, spend and benefits, and you will make sure missed commitments are seen and resolved at the right level.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Set up and control the portfolio

- Maintain one authoritative portfolio of active, proposed, paused and completed transformation projects

- Confirm objective, scope, benefit, sponsor, leader, dependencies, resources and success measures for every proposal

- Apply agreed prioritisation criteria and prepare portfolio options for CTO decisions

- Spot duplicate initiatives, conflicting timelines and resource overload across sites and functions

Define and plan projects

- Build charters and business cases with technical and operational owners

- Create work breakdown structures, milestone plans, Gantt charts, RACI matrices and stage gates, scaled to each project's size and risk

- Make acceptance criteria, assumptions, exclusions and dependencies explicit before execution starts

- Set schedule, cost and benefit baselines after sponsor approval

Track execution and escalate

- Collect evidence-based updates and keep milestone, action, RAID, decision and change-control records current

- Run several projects at once and separate genuine critical-path risk from routine activity

- Follow up firmly on overdue commitments and record revised dates, consequences and recovery actions

- Escalate unresolved constraints with facts, impact, options and the decision required

Run governance that respects people's time

- Plan kick-offs, working reviews, steering committees, stage-gate reviews and closures

- Issue focused agendas and pre-reads, record decisions, and publish actions with owners and due dates

- Design workflows for initiation, approval, change control, benefit validation and closure

- Replace repetitive status meetings with dashboards and exception-based reviews

Make the portfolio visible

- Build concise visual views of portfolio health, critical paths, dependencies, shortfalls and decisions needed

- Maintain dashboards with consistent status definitions and drill-down to evidence

- Reconcile project figures with Finance, Operations, HR, IT and Engineering, and flag anything unverified

- Prepare management presentations that separate results, forecasts, risks and requests for decision

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Must have

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, business, finance or a related discipline

- 3–5 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years managing or governing multiple cross-functional projects

- At least 2 years in manufacturing, industrial operations or a closely related environment

- Proven ability to influence across functions without direct authority

- Strong command of project chartering, WBS, critical-path analysis, RAID and decision logs, change control, stage gates and benefit tracking

- Strong Excel and PowerPoint; working knowledge of Power BI and MS Project or equivalent

- Concise written and spoken English

Good to have

- Postgraduate qualification in operations, business or project management

- Experience supporting a senior transformation, operations or programme leader

- Portfolio management across capital, digital, operational and people workstreams

- Experience coordinating analysts or project coordinators

- High-mix, labour-intensive or precision manufacturing exposure

- Jewellery, diamond, luxury or precious-material operations experience (not mandatory)

- Hindi or Gujarati, for site coordination

WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

Someone who follows up persistently and respectfully, including with senior colleagues; communicates in facts and is confident enough to challenge unsupported claims; knows when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate it; and is meticulously organised. You will be a neutral facilitator across competing priorities, clear on the line between coordinating work and owning it.

If you want to be the engine room of a major transformation in one of India's leading jewellery groups, we would like to hear from you. Apply through this post.

* Electrolysis - Green Hydrogen & Chlor Alkali Technology Provider for a livable planet.
* Working on Global clients.
* You will be part of new establishment for upcoming generation.
* Company believes in Innovation and Employee Empowerment.
* Excellent work culture

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy a major step towards a climate-neutrality. thyssenkrupp nucera successfully made an IPO in July and is a member of the SDAX of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since September 2023. www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

title: Senior Applications Technical Specialist
description:

+ Coordinate in-house education, promotion and awareness programs for project staff and business unit managers

****About You****
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  
Job Specific skills
  
  

* 5+ years’ experience with Materials Management systems usage, support, administration, and configuration preferably AVEVA ERM
* Comprehensive understanding of Materials Management principles.
* Strong overall understanding of project requirements, deliverables and workflows.
* Ability to effectively deliver presentations to both internal and external stakeholders.

**Industry Specific Experience:**

* 10+ years of Materials Management experience; preferably in MTO, Engineering requisitions, Supply Chain and Site Materials Management for EPC projects.

Education
  
  

* A recognised degree or equivalent qualification/experience.

**IT Skills:**

* Proficient in MS Office applications.
* General knowledge of systems (operting systems, software installation, and configurations).

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, detail oriented, self-motivated, and efficient.
* Ability to apply intelligence and knowledge to problem solving and meet deadlines.
* Be able to coordinate work with other offices.
* Be a team player and able to work effectively in a virtual team.
* Be service oriented.

Job Specific skills
  
  

* 5+ years’ experience with Materials Management systems usage, support, administration, and configuration preferably AVEVA ERM

title: Medical Manager
description:
**Job Location**
MUMBAI GENERAL OFFICE
  
  
**Job Description**
**Location:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Function:**
Research & Development – Medical
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
You will be part of the medical function within P&G’s Research & Development organization, supporting the P&G Health India business from Mumbai. In this role, you will help design and deliver medical affairs activities for the assigned therapeutic area, ensuring scientific excellence, compliance, and strong cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
As a Medical Manager at Head Office, you will support execution of the medical affairs strategy for the assigned therapy area and enable high-quality scientific engagement with healthcare professionals (HCPs), key opinion leaders (KOLs), and healthcare organizations (HCOs). The role includes scientific communication, claims and content review, evidence support, medical input into product initiatives, and collaboration with Product Research, Regulatory, Product Development, Clinical, Sales, and Marketing teams.
  
  
This role is suited to a medically qualified professional with strong scientific grounding, clear communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced healthcare environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute the medical affairs plan for the assigned therapeutic area in alignment with business priorities and medical strategy.
* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of current clinical practice, treatment trends, competitive therapies, and relevant scientific literature.
* Gather, assess, and communicate medical and scientific insights clearly, accurately, and compliantly to internal and external stakeholders.
* Review and support substantiation of scientific claims, promotional and non-promotional materials, medical communications, and training content to ensure scientific accuracy and compliance.
* Provide medical input across product lifecycle activities, including product development, evidence generation, lifecycle management, medico-marketing initiatives, and registration support for new products or indications.
* Partner cross-functionally with Product Research, Regulatory, Product Development, Clinical, Marketing, and Sales teams to support business needs with sound medical judgment.
* Engage in credible, non-promotional scientific exchange with HCPs, KOLs, and HCOs, and support medical education initiatives such as CMEs, scientific symposia, advisory boards, and expert round tables, where applicable.
* Identify emerging medical insights, unmet needs, and local market feedback, and share them with internal stakeholders to support planning, positioning, and decision-making.
* Support medical information activities, including responses to scientific and medical inquiries, where applicable.
* Contribute to evidence-generation initiatives, publication planning, dissemination activities, scientific presentations, labelling review, and other approved medical-regulatory documentation in line with SOPs and local requirements.
* Deliver technical and scientific training for internal teams, including field force and cross-functional partners, as needed.
* Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with company policies, medical governance requirements, local regulations, and applicable industry standards, including compliant HCP engagement.

**Qualifications**

* Medical degree or equivalent medical/scientific qualification required.
* 3-7 years of relevant experience in medical affairs, medical communications, medical support, scientific roles, or related positions within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry preferred.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong ability to interpret medical, clinical, and scientific data and translate it into clear, relevant, and compliant medical communication.
* Good understanding of medical affairs processes, scientific exchange, claims support, medical governance, and compliant engagement practices.
* Experience in scientific review and approval of promotional and non-promotional materials.
* Familiarity with HCP interaction processes and documentation requirements.
* Ability to support KOL/HCO engagement plans, advisory boards, expert round tables, and medical education initiatives.
* Familiarity with evidence-generation activities, publication planning, scientific dissemination, and related medical-regulatory documentation.
* Experience in delivering technical/scientific training for field force and internal cross-functional teams.
* Ability to incorporate external medical insights into internal planning to strengthen product positioning and local activation plans.
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multifunctional teams.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities with discipline and accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**What We Are Looking For**

* A strong scientific and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to apply medical knowledge in a business-relevant and compliant manner.
* Comfort working across functions and contributing to projects involving science, regulation, product development, and HCP engagement.
* High learning agility, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to quality, accuracy, and compliance.
* Ability to build credibility through evidence-based, balanced, and non-promotional scientific communication.
* Strong planning and execution capability for local medical initiatives that support both medical strategy and business priorities.

**Job Qualifications**

* Medical degree or equivalent medical/scientific qualification required.
* 3-7 years of relevant experience in medical affairs, medical communications, medical support, scientific roles, or related positions within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry preferred.

Full time

title: Lead - Estimation & Proposals

* Proposal Documentation: Maintain estimation databases, costing templates, technical documents and records of submitted proposals and awarded projects.

**Qualifications/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Ceramic Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.

* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset.

At Alkegen, we strive every day to help people – ALL PEOPLE – breathe easier, live greener and go further than ever before.
