description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS Business Consulting – Life & Annuity Senior position:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Lead end-to-end Policy Administration System (PAS) conversion programs (legacy to modern platforms) across Life, Annuity, and Group business lines, ensuring alignment with business goals and regulatory requirements.
* Define and validate data conversion strategy, including Data profiling, cleansing, mapping, and transformation rules.
* Work closely with source and target system experts to define Data architecture and conversion design decisions, mapping logic and transformation rules, data cleansing and standardization criteria.
* Design and oversee conversion execution cycles, including Build cycles and iterative mock conversions, Monitoring data quality, reconciliation, and functional validation, ensuring readiness for go-live based on predefined acceptance criteria.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life & Annuity insurance domain.

**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on expertise in policy administration data migration, including Conversion strategy and execution planning, Data quality frameworks, audit controls, and governance practices
* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

**Ideally, good to have**

* Good understanding of SQL, stored procedures, and ETL frameworks, with the ability to support data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting in large-scale migration programs.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Biomedical Engineer Manager
description:
**Biomedical Engineer**

**Lower Parel, Mumbai**

**Full-Time**

**Role Summary**

The Biomedical Engineer will support the planning, evaluation, procurement, integration, deployment, and maintenance of medical devices used in AI-enabled public health screening programs.

The person will work closely with the program team, software development team, clinical experts, vendors, and field teams to ensure that devices are clinically appropriate, technically reliable, integration-ready, and suitable for field implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Support evaluation of medical devices from both clinical-use and technology-integration perspectives.

Assess device suitability for AI-enabled screening workflows, including image quality, data output, connectivity, metadata availability, and software compatibility.

Coordinate with IT/software teams for SDK/API integration of diagnostic devices with the AI platform

Ensure that device outputs such as images, readings, reports, and metadata can be transferred securely into the project platform without unnecessary third-party data dependency.

Support technical discussions related to OEM, partnerships, white-labelling, co-development, and possible future manufacturing of selected devices.

Support device testing during pilot and pre-deployment phases

Test device usability in field conditions, including PHC, HWC, camp, and outreach settings

Document device performance, errors, user feedback, and technical issues

Support validation of device output quality before clinical use

Ensure availability of required device accessories, consumables, chargers, cables, calibration tools, and manuals.

Support procurement team in preparing technical specifications and BOQ for devices and consumables

Review vendor quotations from a technical perspective

Ensure device documentation is complete, including certifications, manuals, calibration certificates, warranty documents, and regulatory approvals

Support compliance review for medical devices as per applicable Indian regulatory requirements

Ensure proper documentation for device-related incidents and corrective actions.

**Required Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering / Medical Electronics / Instrumentation Engineering / Electronics Engineering.

Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Technology, or Healthcare Technology will be an added advantage.

Required Experience

2–5 years of experience in biomedical equipment management, medical device implementation, hospital biomedical engineering, or medtech device support.

Experience with diagnostic devices, imaging devices, or point-of-care devices is preferred.

Prior experience in public health programs, field deployment, or healthcare technology projects will be an advantage.

* Experience in device market research, integration with software platforms, SDK/API coordination, or digital health systems will be preferred.

title: Founders Office Intern
description:
**Founder’s Office | Business & Growth**

**Paid Internship | Mumbai | Hybrid**

Want to understand how an early-stage company actually gets built and taken to market?

PockyDoc is building a connected health and wellness ecosystem across prevention, care and recovery. We’re now taking the product to market starting with Mumbai.

title: Corporate Quality MIS Analyst - JG
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai (Corporate Office)
  
  
**Experience:**
3-7 Years
  
  
**Industry:**
Automotive / Auto Components / Wiring Harness
  
  
**Job Overview**
An established manufacturing organization is looking for a
**Corporate Quality MIS Analyst**
to support quality data management, reporting, and performance analysis across multiple manufacturing locations. This role will focus on consolidating quality metrics, preparing management reports, identifying trends, and driving data-based decision-making within the quality function.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Consolidate quality MIS reports and performance data from multiple plants.
* Track and analyze key quality metrics such as PPM, rejection rates, rework, FPY, customer complaints, CAPA, and 8D reports.
* Prepare dashboards, trend analyses, MIS reports, and presentations for management review.
* Coordinate with plant quality teams to ensure timely and accurate reporting.
* Identify quality trends, deviations, and opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain centralized quality databases and reporting systems.
* Support quality review meetings with data insights and performance summaries.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 3-7 years of experience in Automotive, Wiring Harness, Auto Components, or a related manufacturing industry.
* Strong understanding of Quality MIS, KPI reporting, and data analysis.
* Proficient in MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, advanced formulas), dashboards, and PowerPoint.
* Knowledge of quality methodologies including 7 QC Tools, 8D, CAPA, and Root Cause Analysis.
* Strong analytical, reporting, coordination, and communication skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams and multiple manufacturing locations.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience working in a corporate quality, plant quality, quality systems, or quality reporting role.
* Exposure to automotive quality standards and manufacturing environments.
* Comfortable handling large datasets and preparing management-level reports.

**What You'll Bring**

* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving ability.
* Ability to convert quality data into actionable insights.
* Excellent organizational and stakeholder coordination skills.

title: Engagement Manager
description:
**About the Role**

You will be embedded in the product and delivery team, working closely with engineering leads, product managers, and client-facing teams. You will interface regularly with senior stakeholders — both internal and at client organizations — to ensure programs are defined, tracked, and delivered with precision.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the full program lifecycle: requirements gathering, sprint planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and release coordination
* Work with engineering teams to translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Drive system integrations with enterprise clients — APIs, SSO, MDM, DLP, and enterprise infrastructure components
* Manage technical onboarding for enterprise deployments, ensuring smooth configuration, data migration, and go-live execution
* Identify technical bottlenecks, escalate risks proactively, and drive resolution across cross-functional teams
* Maintain program dashboards, technical documentation, integration runbooks, and delivery trackers
* Collaborate with QA to define test plans, oversee UAT cycles, and ensure quality gates are met before release
* Act as the single point of contact for assigned enterprise accounts post-deployment, managing stakeholder communications and escalations
* Coordinate with client CIOs, CISOs, and IT teams to align on timelines, scope changes, and delivery expectations
* Support the business team in scoping new client requirements, estimating delivery effort, and contributing to proposals
* Contribute to client health reviews, ensuring measurable outcomes and long-term retention

**Requirements**

* 2 – 4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Manager, or Technical Project Manager — preferably in a SaaS, enterprise tech, or consulting environment
* Prior experience in a BA or PM role is essential — you must have owned requirements, written specs, and managed delivery timelines
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology environments: APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, security protocols, and enterprise IT workflows
* Proficiency with program management tools (Jira, Confluence, Asana, or equivalents) and documentation practices
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you must be equally comfortable writing a technical specification and presenting a program update to a CXO
* Ability to distil complex technical topics into clear, structured language for both technical and non-technical audiences
* High ownership mindset — you notice what needs doing and you do it without being told

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or engineering degree from a reputed institution preferred; equivalent demonstrated capability will be considered

title: Associate
description:
The Social Impact Associate will lead and support research, monitoring, evaluation, impact assessment, and advisory engagements across the social sector. The role requires a strong understanding of development themes such as education, livelihoods, skilling, healthcare, women empowerment, financial inclusion, climate resilience, and community development. The consultant will be responsible for designing robust research frameworks, conducting data-driven analysis, generating strategic insights, and supporting clients in measuring and enhancing social impact.

Key Responsibilities

**Research & Evaluation**

* Design and implement impact assessments, baseline studies, endline evaluations, needs assessments, and thematic research studies.
* Develop Theory of Change, Logical Frameworks, evaluation matrices, and KPI frameworks.
* Design quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, sampling frameworks, and data collection tools.
* Conduct data analysis and synthesize findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Assess program effectiveness, efficiency, relevance, sustainability, and impact using established evaluation frameworks.

**Project Delivery**

* Manage end-to-end execution of research and evaluation assignments.
* Coordinate with field agencies, enumerators, and technical experts to ensure high-quality data collection.
* Monitor project timelines, quality standards, and client deliverables.
* Lead stakeholder consultations, KIIs, FGDs, workshops, and client discussions.

**Strategic Advisory**

* Support CSR strategy, portfolio reviews, program design, and social sector advisory assignments.
* Identify opportunities for program strengthening and improved social outcomes.
* Translate research findings into strategic recommendations for corporates, foundations, and development organizations.

**Reporting & Communication**

* Prepare client-ready reports, presentations, dashboards, and thought leadership pieces.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders and client leadership teams.
* Develop case studies, success stories, and knowledge products.

Desired Qualifications

* Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Development Studies, Social Work, Sociology, Statistics, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in social sector consulting, impact assessment, monitoring & evaluation, or development research.
* Strong understanding of research methodologies, statistical concepts, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience working with CSR programs, foundations, government initiatives, or development projects.

Key Skills

* Impact Assessment & Evaluation
* Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL)
* Qualitative & Quantitative Research
* Survey Design & Sampling
* Data Analysis and Interpretation
* Report Writing & Presentation Development
* Stakeholder Management
* Project Management
* Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and research tools

title: Workday Integrations/Studio Consulting (Global Delivery Center)
description:

title: Lead Design & Engineering
description:
Job Requirements
  
  
**Why work for us?**
Alkegen brings together two of the world’s leading specialty materials companies to create one new, innovation-driven leader focused on battery technologies, filtration media, and specialty insulation and sealing materials. Through global reach and breakthrough inventions, we’re delivering products that enable the world to breathe easier, live greener, and go further than ever before.
  
  
With over 60 manufacturing facilities with a global workforce of over 9,000 of the industry’s most experienced talent, including insulation and filtration experts, Alkegen is uniquely positioned to help customers impact the environment in meaningful ways.
  
  
Alkegen offers a range of dynamic career opportunities with globe-spanning reach. From production operators to engineers, technicians to specialists, sales to leadership, we’re always looking for top talent ready to bring their best. Come grow with us!
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Job Description - Application Engineer (Design & Engineering)**

* Technical Support: Develop technically sound insulation and refractory solutions for HPI/CPI, steel, aluminium, power, cement and other high-temperature industries.
* Design & Engineering: Develop insulation and refractory lining designs based on operating temperature, process conditions, equipment geometry and customer specifications.
* Engineering Drawings: Prepare/review lining layouts, sectional details, material drawings and installation drawings using AutoCAD or similar tools.
* BOM/MTO: Prepare accurate material take-offs, BOM/MTO and engineering quantities based on lining drawings and approved designs.
* Thermal Calculations: Perform heat-loss, cold-face temperature, thermal conductivity and energy-saving calculations for insulation systems.
* Material Selection: Select suitable CF, PCW, refractory and auxiliary materials based on temperature, atmosphere, mechanical and chemical conditions.
* Project & Site Support: Provide technical support for site surveys, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, conducting presentations and product demonstrations to showcase the benefits and applications of Alkegen’s materials.
* Market Analysis: Stay informed about industry trends, competitive products, and customer requirements to identify opportunities for product improvement and new applications.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, marketing, and engineering teams to ensure alignment on product capabilities and market positioning. Provide technical insights to support sales strategies.
* Training and Education: Develop and deliver training materials and sessions for customers and internal teams to enhance understanding of product applications and technical specifications.
* Product Development: Collaborate with R&D and engineering teams to assist in the development and optimization of new products based on customer feedback and market needs.
* Team Development: Mentor junior engineers, share technical knowledge and develop standard engineering tools and practices.
* Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation, including application notes, specifications, and case studies to support customer engagement and product development.

**Qualifications/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Ceramic Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience, preferably with at least 5 years in Ceramic Fibre, Refractory, thermal insulation or high-temperature applications.
* Experience in working 2D/3D design & drafting softwares.
* Good understanding of heat transfer, thermal conductivity, heat-loss calculations and insulation system design.
* Experience in preparing/reviewing engineering drawings, lining layouts, sectional details and BOM/MTO.
* Experience in HPI/CPI, steel, aluminium, power, cement or other process industries is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with API, ASTM, EIL and major EPC/customer specifications is desirable.
* Strong understanding of materials properties and engineering principles related to product applications.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset.
* Proficient in technical documentation and software tools relevant to engineering and project management.

If you are interested in being part of a growing manufacturing team here at Alkegen Pune Plant, then we would love to hear from you.

We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
  
  
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Interfaces with business line growth team and operations to support the process of winning work. Leads responses to client RFI/RFQ/RFPs and applies standard pursuit processes to ensure efficiency in schedule and bid compliance. Responsible for print, electronic and oral proposal deliverables. Provides market research and competitive intelligence and leverages data systems and tools to support proposal strategy and business strategic planning efforts.

* Completes internal debriefs for proposals they lead and reviews debriefs and reviews client feedback on proposals to ensure and demonstrate continuous improvement.
* Has solid working knowledge of company quality procedures and approval processes (legal, contracts, DOA, signatory).
* Liaises with appropriate/relevant business line team, operations, technical, and business development professionals to support or develop marketing information (including but not limited to case studies/project sheets and capabilities summaries).

* Presentation and document formatting skills.

title: Healthcare Content Analyst, Focus Polls
description:
**Overview:**
Guidepoint Insights enables clients to make better-informed decisions through investor-grade surveys, expertly moderated teleconferences, and a growing transcript library. Our team combines former investment professionals, equity research analysts, industry veterans, and scientists to generate content that drives actionable healthcare research.
  
  
We are looking to add
**Healthcare Content Analysts, Focus Polls**
to our team. This role is fundamental to the development, analysis, and presentation of Guidepoint’s healthcare surveys. Healthcare Content Analysts collaborate with analysts to translate investment questions, product catalysts, and healthcare market developments into clear, neutral, and analytically rigorous surveys.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong healthcare research and scientific communication skills with analytical rigor and the ability to develop high-quality surveys and translate quantitative findings into clear, actionable insights for an investment audience
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Independently develop standardized and repeat survey questionnaires using approved templates, historical surveys, company materials, and relevant research
* Research drugs, medical devices, procedures, companies, treatment markets, and other healthcare topics necessary to develop high-quality surveys
* Review and validate expert survey responses for inconsistencies, outliers, and potential data-quality issues
* Analyze survey results to identify adoption trends, utilization patterns, market-share shifts, and competitive dynamics
* Translate quantitative survey findings into investor-ready charts, presentations, and concise, actionable takeaways
* Identify potential survey topics based on product launches, clinical and regulatory catalysts, earnings, industry developments, prior survey performance, and emerging investment debates
* Contribute to the development and the ongoing build-out of Guidepoint’s healthcare knowledge base

**What You Have:**

* Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Public Health, Healthcare, Pharmacy, or a related field; PhD preferred
* 3+ years of experience in medical writing, healthcare research, market research, clinical/scientific communication, or a related field
* Ability to interpret and clearly present scientific, medical, and quantitative data for an investment audience
* Ability to understand the commercial relevance of healthcare data, including product adoption, utilization, market share, competitive dynamics, and patient access
* Strong command of written English; working knowledge of AP style and in-house editorial guidelines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel
* Comfortable working across multiple healthcare subsectors and learning new domains quickly

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive compensation
* Employee medical coverage
* Central office location
* Entrepreneurial environment, autonomy, and fast decisions
* Casual work environment

**About Guidepoint:**
Guidepoint powers end-to-end research workflows for the world’s best research teams.
  
  
Backed by a global network of more than 2 million experts and over 1,600 employees, Guidepoint delivers real-time access to expertise, primary research, and actionable knowledge that help organizations make informed decisions. Through consultations, surveys, events, proprietary content, and AI-enabled tools, we support every stage of the decision-making process—from developing hypotheses and gathering insights to validating assumptions and building conviction for critical decisions.
  
  
At Guidepoint, our success relies on the diversity of our employees, experts, and clients, which enables us to foster meaningful connections and a broad range of perspectives. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment where individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can contribute and succeed.

title: Manager - Scientific Services
description:
**Job Title**
: Manager – Scientific Services
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About Springer Nature**
Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.
  
  
**About The Brand**
Springer Health+, part of the Springer Nature Group, is a global leader in healthcare education and communications. We partner with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare organizations to develop evidence-based scientific communications, medical education initiatives, publications, and strategic Medical Affairs solutions that improve healthcare decision-making and patient outcomes.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Manager - Scientific Services - will lead the development and delivery of high-quality scientific communications and Medical Affairs initiatives for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.
  
  
The role requires a blend of scientific expertise, project leadership, stakeholder engagement, and commercial acumen to deliver impactful solutions and support the growth of Springer Health+'s Scientific Services business in India.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scientific Content & Medical Communications**

* Develop evidence-based scientific content by leveraging strong Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge and Product and Service Knowledge to ensure relevance, accuracy, and scientific rigor.
* Review evidence-based scientific content, ensuring scientific accuracy, quality, compliance, and alignment with client and stakeholder expectations through a Customer-Focused and Action-Oriented approach.
* Develop scientific platforms, advisory board materials, slide decks, publications, manuscripts, literature reviews, and medical education assets that effectively support client objectives and therapeutic communication needs.
* Conduct literature searches, evidence assessments, and scientific analyses utilizing deep Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge and critical evaluation skills.
* Ensure scientific accuracy, quality, and compliance across deliverables while balancing regulatory requirements, business goals, and stakeholder expectations through effective Stakeholder Management.
* Stay abreast of therapeutic advances, emerging evidence, and industry trends to maintain robust scientific expertise and Product and Service Knowledge.

**Medical Affairs & Client Engagement**

* Partner with Medical Affairs teams to support strategic scientific objectives while effectively Balancing Stakeholders and fostering cross-functional collaboration.
* Participate in client meetings, advisory boards, and scientific discussions by applying Consultative Selling techniques and demonstrating strong scientific expertise.
* Provide scientific insights and recommendations that address client needs and support informed decision-making through a Customer-Focused and consultative approach.
* Build strong relationships with clients, KOLs, and healthcare professionals, ensuring long-term engagement, trust, and customer satisfaction.

**KOL Engagement**

* Support identification and engagement of KOLs and external experts by utilizing strong industry networks and Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge.
* Coordinate scientific reviews and expert inputs while effectively balancing diverse stakeholder perspectives and objectives.
* Develop meeting summaries, insight reports, and recommendations that translate expert feedback into actionable scientific and business outcomes.
* Develop national and international medical society and university tie-ups to strengthen scientific collaborations and create opportunities for strategic partnerships and Business Development.

**Project Leadership**

* Manage multiple projects while ensuring quality, timelines, client satisfaction, and efficient resource utilization, supported by sound Financial Acumen and an Action-Oriented mindset.
* Collaborate with medical writers, editors, designers, and project teams to deliver high-quality scientific solutions that meet client requirements.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation plans proactively to ensure successful project execution and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Business Growth**

* Support proposals, capability presentations, and client pitches by combining scientific expertise with Consultative Selling, Business Development, and Product and Service Knowledge.
* Identify growth opportunities within existing and new accounts through a strong understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and business objectives.
* Provide scientific input during project scoping and planning, incorporating Financial Acumen and strategic business considerations to support successful project outcomes.
* Contribute to business expansion efforts by maintaining a customer-centric approach and identifying opportunities to enhance service offerings and client value.

**Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure adherence to industry regulations, ethical standards, and company processes by applying comprehensive Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge and quality-focused practices.
* Participate in quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational excellence, client satisfaction, and service quality.

**Team Development**

* Mentor junior team members and contribute to scientific training programs by sharing expertise in scientific communications, therapeutic areas, and industry best practices.
* Promote knowledge sharing, collaboration, and scientific excellence while fostering a Customer-Focused, Action-Oriented, and high-performance team culture.
* Support the development of team capabilities related to Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge, Product and Service Knowledge, stakeholder management, and business acumen.

**Experience & Qualifications**
**Education**

* MBBS, MD, PharmD, M.Pharm, PhD, Life Sciences, or related healthcare qualification.
* Additional qualifications in Medical Affairs, Medical Writing, Publications, or Management are advantageous.

**Experience**

* 8-10 years' experience in Medical Communications, Medical Affairs, Scientific Services, or Healthcare Communications.
* Proven expertise in scientific content development and client engagement.
* Strong understanding of clinical research, evidence evaluation, and publication practices.
* Familiarity with GPP2022, ICMJE, AMA style, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements.
* Experience in leading expert consensus panels and managing structured scientific consensus initiatives.
* Knowledge of real-world evidence generation, with hands-on experience conducting real-world studies end to end.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Medical Affairs and scientific communication strategy.
* Advisory boards, publications, medical education, and scientific content development.
* Publication planning and evidence generation.
* Pharmaceutical compliance and regulatory awareness.
* Exposure to digital and AI-enabled scientific communication solutions is desirable.

**Key Skills & Leadership Competencies**
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Strategic Thinking: Translates scientific evidence and client needs into actionable solutions.
* Agility & Adaptability: Thrives in fast-paced environments and manages changing priorities effectively.
* Analytical Thinking: Connects disparate information and derives meaningful insights.
* Curiosity & Innovation: Explores emerging science, technologies, and AI-enabled opportunities.
* Communication & Influence: Effectively engages Medical Affairs leaders, KOLs, and cross-functional teams.
* Collaboration & Leadership: Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and the ability to mentor and inspire others.
* Commercial Acumen: Balances scientific rigor with business objectives and identifies growth opportunities.

**Success in This Role**
The successful candidate will combine scientific excellence, strategic thinking, agility, and strong stakeholder management to deliver impactful solutions that create value for clients and support the growth of Springer Health+'s Scientific Services business

* Collaborative Mindset: Strong teamwork orientation with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Job Description – Technical Content Intern [Applied AI]**

**Position**
**Internship**

**Job Location-Mumbai**

**Qualification-**
B.Tech/M.Tech/BSc/MSc in CS, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field [Pursuing or recently graduated]

**Stipend-**
30,000 per month

**Role Overview**

upGrad is building AI-native learning experiences for millions of working professionals globally. As a Technical Content Intern, you will act as the crucial bridge between our Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and our AI-driven video production pipeline. You will transform complex graduate-level AI concepts, from linear algebra to neural network optimization, into structured, visually coherent educational content. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands technical concepts and possesses the editorial rigor to teach them effectively.

**Job Description**

1. **Scripting & Pre-Production**

Review raw educational scripts provided by SMEs for language, flow, and technical accuracy. Translate these into Pre-Production Scripts (PPS), detailing precise visual descriptions and rendering cues for an AI video pipeline utilizing tools like Remotion, Manim, and HeyGen.

1. **Quality Assurance & Feedback**

Collaborate with the Content Lead to review AI-generated video previews, providing structured, actionable feedback to improve visual fidelity and instructional clarity before final rendering.

1. **Live Session Development**

Audit and refine live session learning materials. In cases where SMEs are strictly reviewers, you will independently draft presentation decks, Python code demonstrations, and applied lab assignments, iterating them based on SME feedback.

**Skills required**

* Solid conceptual foundation in machine learning mathematics (linear algebra, probability, calculus) and working knowledge of Python (NumPy, Pandas).
* Exceptional technical writing and editing skills; ability to identify logical gaps and simplify complex technical jargon without compromising epistemic accuracy.
* Strong visual content communication to map abstract mathematical concepts to concrete visual descriptions (e.g., deciding when a concept requires a 2D Cartesian plane versus a UI code-block layout).
* Ability to work independently, manage feedback cycles with technical experts, and communicate clearly.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Position Summary**

The Assistant Manager/Senior Executive – Project Coordinator will serve as a key link between the Revenue team, clients, and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring smooth execution of client requirements from opportunity identification through project handover.

The role combines client solutioning support with project coordination, enabling timely proposal development, efficient internal collaboration, and successful delivery of customized workspace solutions.

The incumbent will coordinate multiple client projects simultaneously while supporting governance, timelines, stakeholder communication, and operational excellence throughout the sales lifecycle.

Success in this position requires strong organization, clear communication, sound project and time management skills, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced, team-focused environment.

*Key Responsibilities:*

**Client Solutioning & Revenue Support**

* Work with the Revenue team to understand client business requirements and translate them into actionable solution plans.
* Support the Revenue team by coordinating with Design, Development, Projects, IT, Procurement, Legal, Finance, Experience, and Operations teams to develop customized workspace solutions.
* Coordinate preparation of test-fit layouts, design briefs, commercial proposals, project budgets, timelines, and RFP responses.
* Assist in creating compelling proposals and presentations that enhance conversion rates.
* Participate in client meetings, site visits, requirement gathering sessions, and solution presentations.

**Project Coordination & Execution**

* Act as the project coordinator for pre-sales and post-sales execution activities.
* Develop and maintain project plans, trackers, milestone dashboards, and risk registers.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Coordinate multiple projects of varying size and timelines concurrently; track progress, flag bottlenecks, and escalate risks with suggested mitigation plans.
* Schedule internal governance meetings and publish MOMs with action owners and timelines.
* Monitor adherence to committed client timelines and track readiness for project handover.
* Support the handover of projects to the Development team post contract signing.
* Join the Revenue team for client site walk-throughs and need-mapping meetings as required.

**Cross-functional Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate across Revenue, Design, Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Procurement, IT, and Experience teams.
* Facilitate timely approvals, documentation, and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support a seamless transition from Sales to Development/Projects after commercial closure.
* Maintain effective communication with internal and external stakeholders on project status and milestones.

**Commercial & Process Excellence**

* Track proposal turnaround time (TAT), project milestones, and revenue pipeline deliverables.
* Support commercial documentation including LOIs, proposals, cost estimates, budgets, and project schedules.
* Maintain and standardize project management templates, trackers, and reporting dashboards.
* Suggest improvements to sales coordination, project governance, and operational efficiency.

**Customer Experience**

* Help manage client expectations through proactive communication and timely updates.
* Coordinate with Operations and Experience teams to support successful project delivery and occupancy readiness.
* Help identify upselling opportunities by noting additional client requirements during project execution.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong project planning, organization, and execution skills.
* Good stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* Customer-centric mindset with commercial awareness.
* High ownership, accountability, and execution focus.

**Key Success Metrics (KPIs)**

* Proposal/RFP turnaround time.
* On-time project milestone completion.
* Sales-to-project handover efficiency.
* Cross-functional SLA adherence.
* Client satisfaction during pre-sales and onboarding.
* Revenue support effectiveness and proposal conversion.
* Project governance and reporting accuracy.
* Process improvement initiatives implemented.

**Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Business Management, Project Management, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in Project Coordination, Client Solutions, Revenue Operations, Program Management, or Commercial Real Estate.
* Preferred experience in Coworking, Commercial Real Estate, Managed Offices, Hospitality, Retail, or Consulting.
* Exposure to cross-functional projects from pre-sales through execution.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Project Management tools, and CRM platforms.
* PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent certification will be an added advantage.

title: Web Content Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Web CMS Expert to lead complex website publishing, CMS operations, platform governance, issue resolution, experimentation enablement, and continuous website improvement.

This role will serve as a subject matter expert for the organization’s CMS and web operations ecosystem. The successful candidate will manage high-impact website changes, guide junior team members, establish publishing and governance standards, investigate complex defects, coordinate cross-functional releases, and support experimentation programs designed to improve user experience and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong CMS expertise with technical troubleshooting, operational leadership, stakeholder management, accessibility, SEO, analytics, and optimization experience.

Key Responsibilities

CMS Operations and Platform Expertise

* Serve as the primary CMS subject matter expert for content authors, publishers, business teams, and technical stakeholders.
* Manage complex content publishing activities across multiple websites, markets, languages, brands, or business units.
* Configure and maintain page templates, reusable components, content fragments, taxonomies, workflows, and publishing rules.
* Review CMS configurations and publishing processes to identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and risk reduction.
* Troubleshoot content authoring, workflow, publishing, rendering, and caching issues.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to define CMS enhancements and platform requirements.
* Support CMS upgrades, releases, migrations, integrations, and platform modernization initiatives.
* Develop and maintain CMS standards, operational procedures, governance documentation, and authoring guidelines.

Advanced Page Creation and Website Enhancements

* Create and manage complex pages, landing pages, campaign experiences, navigation structures, and reusable content modules.
* Translate business and design requirements into scalable CMS solutions using approved templates and components.
* Assess enhancement requests for feasibility, dependencies, accessibility, SEO, analytics, performance, and maintenance impact.
* Collaborate with user experience, design, development, content, marketing, legal, compliance, and analytics teams.
* Ensure page implementations are responsive, accessible, consistent, and aligned with design system standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve component reuse and reduce unnecessary custom development.
* Review and approve high-impact publishing changes before production release.

Access Management and CMS Governance

* Own or oversee CMS user access management, including account provisioning, role assignments, permission changes, periodic reviews, and deactivation.
* Define and maintain role-based access control models in partnership with security and platform teams.
* Ensure access requests follow approval, audit, segregation-of-duties, and least-privilege requirements.

Support internal audits by providing access records, publishing evidence, and process documentation

Job Overview

We are looking for an analytical, execution-focused SEO Analyst to take complete end-to-end ownership of the search engine optimization and digital content ecosystem for Dononman.

In this dual-impact role, you will lead our organic growth strategy by combining technical webmastering, high-ranking blog creation, on-page optimization, and site performance optimization. You will bridge the gap between technical web development and strategic content, ensuring Dononman ranks at the top of search engine results pages (SERPs) while maintaining a fast, seamless user experience.

Key Responsibilities

1. Blog Strategy & Content Creation (Complete Blog Management)

Keyword Strategy: Conduct in-depth keyword research, intent analysis, and competitive gap assessments to identify high-converting content opportunities for Dononman.

End-to-End Blog Publishing: Write, edit, structure, and publish high-quality, engaging, and SEO-optimized blog posts using CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Webflow, or Shopify).

On-Page Optimization: Optimize all blog elements, including titles, meta descriptions, header structures (H1–H4), internal links, URL slugs, image alt text, and schema markup.

Content Lifecycles: Audit and update existing articles regularly to refresh decaying content, fix broken links, and keep rankings competitive.

2. Technical SEO & Webmastering

Site Health & Architecture: Conduct regular technical audits to maintain clean site architecture, crawlability, and indexability.

Core Web Vitals & Speed: Diagnose and optimize page speed, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals performance across desktop and mobile devices.

Technical Fixes: Manage robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, 301 redirects, HTTP status codes (404, 500), and structured data (JSON-LD).

Platform Management: Manage domain configurations, basic CMS maintenance, plugin updates, security monitoring, and coordination with web developers for complex structural modifications.

3. Link Building & Off-Page SEO

Execute high-quality link-building tactics, guest blogging outreach, digital PR, and competitor backlink acquisition strategies.

Monitor backlink profiles, manage toxic links, and execute disavow actions when necessary.

4. Analytics & Reporting

Track, analyze, and report on key organic metrics (organic sessions, keyword rankings, impressions, bounce rates, conversion rates) using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and third-party tools.

Translate raw search data into actionable growth initiatives for the Dononman brand.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 2–4 years of experience as an SEO Analyst, Technical SEO Specialist, or Webmaster with a proven track record of growing organic search traffic.

Technical Proficiency:

Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript principles affecting crawlability, and CMS management (WordPress/Webflow/Custom frameworks).

Hands-on expertise with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Screaming Frog, and Google Tag Manager.

Proficiency in SEO suites such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Keyword Planner.

Content Skills: Exceptional written English skills with the ability to write clear, compelling, and search-optimized blog copy.

Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset capable of diagnosing complex indexing, crawling, or speed issues.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Increase in domain-wide organic traffic and keyword positions for high-intent keywords.

Blog traffic growth, reader engagement, and organic lead/conversion generation.

Improvement in Core Web Vitals scores and zero critical technical/crawling errors.

Acquisition of high-authority, relevant backlinks.

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Experience:**
Minimum 5 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years in Sales / Account Management

**Industry:**
Oil & Gas / Energy

Company Description

**JIACH Energy Solutions (JES)**
is a leading provider of equipment and technical services specializing in
**drilling, completion, and production solutions**
for the oil and gas industry.

With operations across
**UAE – Dubai, Saudi Arabia, and India**
, JES supplies a comprehensive range of products and solutions, including:

* Drilling rig equipment and spares
* Downhole tools
* Instrumentation and automation solutions
* Artificial lift solutions
* Electrical and mechanical equipment
* Inspection, servicing, repair, and maintenance services

JES provides cost-effective inspection, servicing, repair, and overhaul solutions in accordance with applicable
**API standards and industry requirements**
, supported by workshops in
**Dammam, Saudi Arabia, and Mumbai, India**
.

Serving both
**onshore and offshore operations**
, JES is committed to delivering reliable, high-quality equipment and technical services tailored to customer requirements.

The
**JES team comprises experienced technocrats with decades of combined experience in the energy industry**
, enabling us to provide practical, technically sound, and customer-focused solutions.

For more information, visit
**www.jiachenergy.com**

Role Description

JIACH Energy Solutions is looking for an experienced and technically oriented
**Technical Account Manager**
to join our Mumbai team.

The Technical Account Manager will be responsible for managing key customer accounts while providing technical support and coordinating commercial and project-related activities. The role requires a combination of
**technical knowledge, customer relationship management, sales coordination, and project execution skills**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and develop relationships with existing and potential customers in the oil and gas industry.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customers on technical and commercial matters.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable equipment, products, and technical solutions.
* Provide technical support and troubleshoot equipment-related issues, particularly in
  **drilling, completion, and production applications**
  .
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, service, and operations teams to ensure timely project execution and delivery.
* Plan, coordinate, and monitor customer projects from order placement through completion.
* Coordinate service schedules, equipment deliveries, site visits, inspections, repairs, and commissioning activities.
* Support the sales team during customer meetings, technical discussions, enquiries, and proposal development.
* Identify new business opportunities within existing and prospective customer accounts.
* Prepare and follow up on quotations, technical proposals, and commercial requirements in coordination with the internal team.
* Conduct or coordinate technical product training and customer demonstrations where required.
* Maintain regular communication with customers to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
* Collect and communicate customer feedback to internal teams to improve products, services, and solutions.
* Monitor project progress, customer commitments, and delivery schedules.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, opportunities, projects, and account activities.
* Ensure that customer requirements are addressed professionally, efficiently, and within agreed timelines.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in
  **Instrumentation, Electronics OR Electrical Engineering**
* Minimum
  **5 years of professional experience**
  in the oil & gas, energy, drilling, or related industrial sector.
* Minimum
  **2 years of experience in Sales / Account Management**
  is required.
* Proven experience in
  **customer relationship management and account development**
  .
* Strong technical troubleshooting and equipment-support capabilities.
* Experience with drilling, completion, production equipment, or related oilfield services will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of
  **API standards, oilfield equipment, safety requirements, and quality practices**
  is preferred.
* Experience in project coordination and execution.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers, engineers, technicians, suppliers, and internal management.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple customer accounts and priorities.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings, site visits, inspections, and project-related activities as required.

title: Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
description:

Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
ServiceNow
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA

15 years full time education

title: Asset Management - Request for Proposal - Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Bring your writing and project coordination expertise to a collaborative, global team where you can grow your career while helping clients meet their investment needs.
  
  
As a Requests for Proposal Analyst in the Emerging Markets Equity Team, you create and deliver high-quality client proposal content that clearly articulates the firm's value and commitments. You partner with global stakeholders across sales, client service, product specialists, investment specialists, and portfolio teams to gather, validate, and maintain accurate information. You help strengthen the proposal process through standardization and continuous improvement while working across multiple priorities and deadlines.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Draft Requests for Proposal and Requests for Information responses for institutional and wholesale clients and prospects with a strong focus on accuracy and timeliness
* Coordinate concurrent proposal projects, aligning inputs across global internal teams to meet strict deadlines
* Curate a centralized library of current content, including investment strategy descriptions, performance information, compliance details, and legal disclosures
* Validate data and formatting to quickly identify and resolve quality issues before delivery
* Communicate clearly and efficiently with multiple product groups and regional partners throughout the proposal lifecycle
* Enhance the proposal workflow by identifying improvement opportunities and supporting the adoption of standardized templates, best practices, and automation tools

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**

* Hold a post-graduate degree
* Bring 2+ years of experience in a similar role within the asset management industry
* Demonstrate awareness of business risk and compliance procedures
* Manage competing priorities across immediate and short-term deliverables
* Use Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Operate content management systems and proposal automation tools, where applicable
* Communicate effectively in writing and verbally with stakeholders across regions
* Maintain a strong work ethic and positive, collaborative approach

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**

* Demonstrate understanding of the asset management business, asset classes, and investment products
* Evidence experience writing or contributing to Requests for Proposal responses, ideally in asset management
* Gain broad knowledge of assigned J.P. Morgan Asset Management investment products to support timely, accurate responses
* Exhibit financial market awareness and understanding of fund-related concepts
* Hold Chartered Financial Analyst Level I
* Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

description:

Drive successful delivery of business and technology initiatives by leveraging project management, business analysis, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and process improvement capabilities. * Any Graduate

title: Senior bid Manager - Mumbai
description:
At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 110 offices worldwide.

**Job Description**

The Bid Manager will be responsible for driving best practice approaches and high quality bids in our 2000-person strong Turner & Townsend India team. Acting at both an advisory and hands-on level, the successful candidate will be an experienced bid professional with strong stakeholder management skills and a track record for delivering complex proposals in a collaborative environment. They will be confident constructively challenging stakeholders and have an outcome focused, can-do mindset.

Key responsibilities include:

* Lead a best practice approach and the execution of proposals, tenders and bid responses focused on key markets in India. This includes:
  + Reviewing procurement documentation, leading bid go/no go discussions, and formulating a clear plan for delivering a compelling offer.
  + Acting as bid manager by mobilising internal stakeholders, setting timelines and overseeing execution against the plan.
  + Complying with the Turner & Townsend “bid to win” process and governance requirements
  + Facilitating discussions focused on differentiators, win themes and content to ensure high quality answers are developed.
  + Working with Directors and other functional teams to deliver tender responses through collation of information, writing tender responses directly, or supporting others to produce quality responses.
  + Working with external organisations and partners to develop and deliver bids and proposals.
  + Delivering a professional bid that complies with brand guidelines and clearly and succinctly communicates key messages.
  + Providing constructive feedback or escalating concerns to senior leadership and partner organisations throughout the bid and interview process
  + Ensuring that all deadlines are met and that bids are submitted on time, and in the correct manner.
* Supporting positioning activities and Bid Leadership that support high conversion and business development activity. Examples include undertaking competitor research, market analysis or interrogating client feedback.
* Supporting the preparation of other deliverables related to conversion and work winning, such as interview presentation coaching and procurement team engagement.
* Reporting on pipeline and bid conversion at office and sector levels, including providing analysis and commentary on trends.
* Contribute to content libraries and best practice approaches by overseeing maintenance of content and bid libraries.
* Working alongside a team of existing bid professionals
* Support Business Development with other activities, as required

**Qualifications**

* Relevant degree in Business, Marketing, English or engineering.
* Association of Proposal Management Professional (APMP) accreditation desired, or willing to be completed
* Minimum 7 years' experience of bid management and writing successful bid submissions
* Line management experience desirable
* Strong skills in Microsoft office suite, including Powerpoint and Word
* Proof reading skills with a keen eye for accuracy and detail, including ensuring responses adhere to word/page limits
* Organizational skills, with the ability to priorities and meet deadlines while maintaining a high standard of quality
* Communicate confidently and effectively, verbally and in writing and ability to foster credible collaborative relationships
* Team player who is willing to adapt to changing priorities of the business
* Contribute openly to the team with innovations and ideas to ensure the success and development of the company

**Additional Information**

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

title: People Information Analyst II
description:
**About Us**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Purpose**
As the ServiceNow HRSD Product Owner you are part of the People Digital Solutions team within People Digital. This role requires the unique skillset of someone who is a strategic thinker, a visionary, yet can translate that strategy and vision to an executable roadmap and plan. You lead a small team, and work as part of a larger Product, Adoption, Insights and Data Governance subject matter experts spread across the globe. You are required to assess business requirements, drive design discussions and decisions, set requirements and support implementation for your solution as required. You are responsible for coordinating, administering and governing the solution ongoing. You will ensure you are well informed as to the People, People Digital and Regions strategies when designing and enhancing your specific solution. You will believe that People digital solutions are an enabler of the culture and performance we want to create for our organisation, and you will be a thought leader in this space with a key focus on user experience. You will ensure the solution meets our regulatory, compliance, governance and ethical standards and effectively manage business risk. You will work in a structured way to project management methodology to ensure the stability of the solution and critical business processes. You will effectively collaborate with the Digital team, who have responsibility for configuration.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a People Information Analyst IIwith Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  

* In partnership with key stakeholders.
* Set the vision and strategic drivers of the HRSD product that aligns to the broader ServiceNow platform strategy and the People Digital / ERP strategy.
* Create a multi-year strategic and outcome-based HRSD roadmap to realize the vision.
* Create quarterly objectives or goals of the HRSD product to execute the roadmap.
* Provide thought leadership and the ‘art of the possible’ as it relates to your solution, including new functionality and product road maps.
* Strategically align ServiceNow initiatives to meet the needs of the entire People technology ecosystem including Oracle, Eightfold.ai, Taleo, Appreciate and SuccessFactors.
* Drive holistic solution design for ServiceNow as the experience layer and one start shop for all People experiences. This requires a ‘broader than just ServiceNow’ view of the capability of the People technologies and their functionality so we can create the best experience for our Worley people.
* Document business requirements and manage their timely approval for both large and small initiatives.
* Work collaboratively with our Partners in Digital, who build our solution. Support testing of new functionality. Identify and recommend solution upgrades and enhancements.
* The ability to be innovative and bring creative solutions to complex problems.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* The ability to successfully manage and prioritise ServiceNow demand management (using ServiceNow CIM) and external support vendors to ensure timely, high quality outcomes that meet the stated business need and are in line with our HRSD strategy.
* The ability to successfully escalate, manage and hold to account external support vendors.
* Partner successfully with the ServiceNow vendor to bring best practice to Worley, the get the greatest value from our instance and to be seen as a best practice ServiceNow customer by the external market.
* Assess business requirements, drive design discussions, set requirements and support go-lives/ enhancements as required while actively prioritising and manage the backlog.
* Create project plans and structured methodologies and templates for your own work areas, and input into those owned by others.
* Partner effectively with the wider People function to ensure the solution supports our People Strategy ongoing.
* Support the development and maintenance of standards, procedures, Reference Guides, FAQ documentation and resources to support all system users.
* Maintain the administration of the solution and programs.
* Manage forms, workflow, reports and documentation for the solution.
* Conduct routine reporting and analysis of the solution and programs.
* Coordinate the migration of data and documents as needed.
* Meet our regulatory, compliance, governance and ethical standards and effectively manage business risk.
* Identify and share actionable insights from data to support meeting business needs, optimizing opportunities, improving the employee experience and reducing ‘pain’ points or ‘friction’ in the systems.
* Aim for full systems functionality available is deployed to its maximum potential in the Regions.
* Contribute to periodic review of Vendor performance against performance criteria.
* Design meets the needs of the organisation.
* Issue and incident performance data.
* People Digital projects are delivered against the plan and to expected quality.
* Collaborate with Business Partners to maximise global standard and trends and solutions as first priority before customising for Region.
* Attendance and adoption of training is met or exceeded.
* Voice of the Customer (Stakeholder feedback).

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Undergraduate or postgraduate formal qualification in either Information Technology, Human Resources, Business/ Administration or equivalent experience in in administering a similar solution.
* Experience in design and implementation of enterprise-wide HR digital initiatives, project and change management, ideally in a complex global organisation.
* Functional knowledge and experience in managing a similar solution previously. Experience with Tier 1 Cloud solutions.
* Experience consulting with a wide range of global stakeholders in and out of the People function.
* Able to work independently, manage priorities, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Flexibility in working hours. There may be some regular calls outside of normal business hours to connect with global team.
* Experience working in regional or global team (desirable).

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Automation Configurator, Senior Manager
description:

we are looking for Senior Manager – Low‑Code / No‑Code Configurator & Delivery Support Analyst supports the
**build, enhancement, and maintenance of low‑code / no‑code automation and reconciliation solutions**
across State Street Markets Operations.
  
  
The role is primarily
**hands‑on and execution‑focused**
, supporting Delivery Managers and Product Owners in implementing efficiency initiatives. The role requires efficient contribution in the
**solution configuration, testing, BAU support, and automation opportunity identification**
, while operating within established delivery governance and risk standards.
  
  
The candidate is someone with a
**proven record of technology project execution and ability to get hands on when it comes to analysis, development and execution**
, someone with creativity and self-motivation to deliver on mission critical projects.
  
  
****Why Is This Role Important To Us:****
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets. When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to State Street Markets business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

* Implement configuration changes and enhancements.
* Adhere to defined platform standards, performance expectations, and documentation requirements
* Delivery & Execution

* Assist Delivery Managers in tracking tasks, risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones
* Participate in solution walkthroughs, validation sessions, and release activities
* Ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables within agreed scope and timelines
