* Work with business groups to understand process pain points and design solutions with focus on risk reduction and capacity saves.
* Support identification of automation opportunities using existing tools (reconciliation platforms, robotics, Python, low‑code solutions)
* Assist with requirement clarification, data analysis, and feasibility inputs
* Maintain clear and professional communication with stakeholders
* Quality, Testing & Controls
* Execute unit testing and support functional and user acceptance testing
* Validate configurations against acceptance criteria and documented requirements
* Follow defined risk, control, and change management standards
* Support audit and control requirements through documentation and evidence preparation
* BAU Support & Continuous Improvement
* Support ongoing development, maintenance, and BAU changes for existing automation solutions
* Assist in troubleshooting and resolving production issues
* Maintain configuration and user documentation for knowledge transfer
* Contribute ideas for standardization, reuse, and incremental efficiency improvements

****Required Skills & Experience****
**Technical / Functional**

* Exposure to Low‑Code / No‑Code platforms (Microsoft Power Platform preferred)
* Exposure or interest in reconciliation tools (e.g., Xceptor, DUCO or similar)
* Strong working knowledge of Excel (VBA/macros desirable)
* looking for 10-14 years of experience
* Exposure to automation technologies (RPA, scripting, Python) is a plus
* Understanding of operational processes and data flows within Financial Services
* Should be flexible to work in US Shift :Shit Timing : 06:00 PM - 03:00 AM IST
* Work Location: Mumbai/ Bangalore/ Hyderabad

**Professional & Behavioral**

* Strong attention to detail with an execution‑focused mindset
* Ability to follow defined delivery and governance standards
* Willingness to learn and develop solution and delivery skills
* Clear communication and teamwork in a multi‑stakeholder environment

****Education & Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Finance, or related discipline
* Prior experience in Financial Services Operations or Technology/Automation support roles preferred

**Level Expectations**

* Works independently on defined configuration and build tasks

title: Senior Program Associate- Food Waste (Mumbai)
description:
**About Us**
WRI India, an independent knowledge organisation registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development. Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well-being. Know more: wri-india.org
  
  
**Program Overview For Food, Land And Water**
WRI India’s Food, Land and Water program aims to inform India’s transition towards sustainable and resilient food and land use systems focusing on developing interdisciplinary nature-based solutions like sustainable agriculture and landscape restoration to mitigate climate impacts, enhance jobs and livelihoods and improve nutritional security. To catalyse systems change with a focus on circular food systems in India, we also focus on developing equitable strategies to reduce food loss and food waste and mitigate climate impacts.
  
  
With broader systems change and food systems perspective, we work with diverse stakeholders like governments, businesses, civil society partners and farmer producer organizations to inform and develop land use strategies based on robust evidence and analysis to build the resilience of local communities to mitigate climate impacts, bridge capacity gaps, monitor progress, and inform a pathway to building a restoration economy for people, nature, and climate. For more details, refer to the webpage - Reduce | WRI INDIA (wri-india.org)
  
  
**Job Highlight**
WRI India is seeking a Senior Program Associate based in Bengaluru to support the development and management of a city-level Food Waste Coalition focused on reducing food waste. The role will involve stakeholder mapping and engagement, coalition coordination, partnership development, implementation support, and knowledge generation.
  
  
The role will also involve identifying and engaging emerging technology and service providers working on food waste prevention, diversion, treatment, traceability, and circular resource recovery solutions across India. The selected candidate will help assess scalable and context-appropriate solutions for Bengaluru, facilitate knowledge exchange within the coalition, and support implementation partnerships that can strengthen the city’s food waste management ecosystem.
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Stakeholder management and partnerships (50%):
* Map and engage stakeholders across city’s food and waste ecosystem, including government agencies, MSMEs, hospitality businesses, food service providers, bulk waste generators, waste processors, technology companies, recyclers, NGOs, waste picker organizations, and informal food vendors.
* Identify, engage, and track emerging technologies, business models, and operational approaches for food waste prevention, redistribution, treatment, and landfill diversion relevant to cities.
* Support evaluation, onboarding, and coordination of implementation partners and solution providers for pilots and city level interventions.
* Build and coordinate a city-level Food Waste Coalition to drive collaborative action on food waste reduction, diversion, and circular food systems.
* Convene meetings, workshops, roundtables, and stakeholder consultations to strengthen collaboration and knowledge sharing across the coalition.
* Manage relationships with municipal agencies, industry associations, businesses, and implementation partners to support project delivery and stakeholder alignment.
* Identify opportunities for partnerships, pilots, and collaborative initiatives that advance circular food systems and reduce food waste.
* Research and communication (50%):
* Conduct research and analysis on food waste management, circular economy solutions, and urban waste systems to support evidence based recommendations and program strategy.
* Analyse and compile project learnings, emerging practices and case studies, and contribute to the development of knowledge products including reports, presentations, briefing notes, and communication materials.
* Develop implementation strategy, maintain project trackers, monitor timelines, and support reporting on project milestones and deliverables.
* Development and delivery of training sessions, guidance materials, and capacity building resources on food waste measurement, reporting, and diversion tracking for coalition members.
* External communications and stakeholder outreach through presentations, convenings, newsletters, and other dissemination activities.

**What Will You Need**

* Master’s degree in environmental management, urban planning, waste management, sustainability, public policy, development studies, business administration, or related disciplines.
* 4–7 years of relevant work experience in urban sustainability, circular economy, waste management, food systems or related sectors.
* Strong understanding of urban waste management systems, food waste ecosystems, circular economy approaches, and landfill diversion strategies.
* Familiarity with food waste technologies, decentralized waste processing systems, waste treatment solutions, or circular economy innovations in India.
* Experience working with diverse stakeholders such as government agencies, MSMEs, food businesses, waste processors, technology providers, civil society organizations, or informal sector actors.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management and partnership-building experience, including the ability to convene and engage stakeholders across sectors.
* Understanding of city specific (Pune/Benagluru/Mumbai) waste management and food business ecosystem will be an advantage.
* Proficiency in relevant local languages will be an added advantage.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong skills in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including data tracking, analysis, reporting, and presentation development.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take initiative in a dynamic work environment.
* Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in evolving and fast-paced program environments.
* Ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary and cross-functional teams.

**Potential Salary and Benefits:**
***14,00,000 to 17,50,000 Per Annum***
Salary shall be commensurate with experience and skills. WRI offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.

: 2 years Extendable based on performance and project requirements

As soon as possible

Qualified applicants should apply online at www.wri.org/careers. All applications must be submitted online through this career portal in order to be formally considered. Only select applicants will be contacted for interview. There will be a writing test conducted with final candidates. Please do not contact program staff directly for this position.

title: Associate, Implementation Consultant
description:
**About This Role**
**About this role**
Are you an Investment Accounting professional searching for an exciting, significant, multi-faceted opportunity with the world's largest asset manager? If you pride yourself on building positive relationships, developing process solutions and bringing strategic visions to fruition, then look no further! BlackRock is pursuing an Associate to become a part of the team. We recognize that strength comes from diversity, and will accept rare skills, eagerness, and passion. All the while supporting the freedom to grow authoritatively and as an individual.
  
  
We know you want to feel valued every single day and be recognized for contributions! At BlackRock, we strive to equip our employees and actively engage their involvement in our success. Our technology and services empower millions of investors to save for retirement, pay for college, buy a home and improve their financial well-being. Join the team and experience what it feels like to be part of an organization that makes a difference.
  
  
Our Investment Accounting Group provides accounting and regulatory data services to insurance clients. Our accounting services include the reconciliation, accounting for assets, along with preparation and oversight of monthly reporting packages and regulatory schedules.
  
  
**The Role**
Responsible for supporting our investment accounting platform migrations team, meeting the needs and evolving priorities of our clients. Focus on supporting our strategic initiative to deliver our new and proprietary accounting software to existing BlackRock clients. Specifically, the Associate will support asset onboarding, variance analysis, stabilization of the monthly close process, and the transition to the client’s production support team. A key function will be improving processes controls, and user experience, often while collaborating with other areas of the BlackRock organization. This role supports many opportunities for continued professional development with a career path within the group, or into other operating teams or client-facing business areas across BlackRock. Our suite of services provided to our clients offers opportunities for further personal learning, both in terms of the product types and accounting complexities, as well as the ongoing development of technical strengths.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Develop a detailed knowledge of BlackRock’s capabilities, products and services supporting our clients. Keep abreast of and optimally communicate the implications of the evolving regulatory landscape and new accounting pronouncements to ensure compliance by our insurance company, across multiple bases of accounting i.e. IFRS, US Statutory, US GAAP, etc.
* Implement and operate on newly developed BlackRock proprietary accounting software. Provide feedback and improvement ideas to enhance system functionality. Leverage your analytical abilities to identify and assess system challenges and inefficiencies utilizing a strong aptitude for the understanding of how accounting data is supported through the new platform. This includes an understanding of data flow from the underlying transaction through the journal entries/trial balance and ultimately, financial reporting.
* Partner with other BlackRock teams, including product and engineering. Provide client-transition updates to internal groups highlighting any migration challenges. Support accounting on cross-functional projects and working groups in support of delivering key business and client objectives.
* Contribute to the continual development of the investment reporting production and control processes to optimize efficiency, mitigate risk and incorporate business and product changes, ensuring procedures are maintained in line with all current practices.

**Experience Required**

* Minimum 5 years of proven experience in investments/markets with a focus on investment accounting
* Comprehensive understanding of key accounting reports (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and Trial Balance)
* Proven track record of demonstrating analytical and problem-solving skills
* Experience implementing accounting systems preferred
* Knowledgeable in regulatory and accounting standards
* Experience with the following financial instruments; securities, loans, derivatives, alternatives, and mortgages
* Familiarity with product-specific financial reporting and disclosures
* Continuous operational improvement and control enhancement mentality
* Fluency (written and oral) in English required

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection.  Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
  
  
Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
  
  
The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications.  The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting & regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1) understanding the Change, (2) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams & Users until implementation of the Change.  It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements.  The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements.  This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc.  Collaborate with the Users & procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in-house GRIFFIN & AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology & Testing Teams where relevant.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
  
  
Certifications If Any - AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
  
  
**Experience Range\***
5 to 8 years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast-paced, every-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.

**Job Summary:**
As a Service Operating Model & Process Design Team Lead/Consultant, you will support process and service transformation engagements, from assessing market, customer, and technology shifts through defining future-state process and service strategies and enabling adoption. You will combine process re-engineering and Lean Six Sigma rigor with customer experience design to diagnose service friction, quantify its impact, and design practical future-state processes, operating models, technology enablement, and AI integration. You will produce structured analytical work and supporting materials that enable senior practitioners to shape transformation recommendations.

* Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for the assigned domain.
* Map and model current-state and future-state service processes using structured notation and modelling tools; document handoffs, decision points, and channel transitions across the customer journey.
* Apply Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value stream mapping, and root cause analysis, to identify service-process inefficiencies and quantify improvement opportunities.
* Develop customer journey maps and service blueprints that identify key touchpoints, friction points, and opportunities to improve experience and efficiency.
* Conduct process analysis and support the delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations, including contact centre and customer service technology.
* Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools; connect process metrics to customer outcomes such as first contact resolution, handling time, containment, and satisfaction.
* Conduct benchmarking analysis using AI-accelerated industry and peer-comparison tools.
* Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.
* Use relevant AI tools across tasks and deliverable creation, including creating agents and other tools that support analysis and delivery.
* Apply industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.

**Professional & Technical Skills:**
**Basic Qualification**
:
  
  

* Proficiency in process modelling tools and software such as Visio, ARIS, or Signavio.
* Experience with process mining and data analytics tools such as Celonis or Power Automate.
* Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into business-process and customer-service design.
* Exposure to customer service or contact centre operations, including familiarity with core service metrics.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project-management skills.
* Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations for senior review.

**Preferred Qualification:**

* Experience in a management consulting firm.
* Exposure to CRM or contact centre platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys, or Amazon Connect.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms.
* Experience working on proposals and contributing to business-development activities.
* Lean Six Sigma certification, with Green Belt or above preferred.

**Additional Information:**

* The ideal candidate combines process-analysis capability, customer-centric service design, AI-enabled transformation, and the ability to develop structured recommendations.
* The role requires growing fluency in process disciplines and the ability to design interactions among people, AI agents, and processes across the service journey.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

description:

You will undertake projects encompassing all aspects of shipboard systems including large scale system roll-outs, computer/communication system installation and support.
  
  
You must balance the ability to participate within dynamic teams with the skill to satisfy the diverse requirements of our clients, group offices and ships.
  
  
The projects you will undertake may require you to travel to managed vessels or other group offices worldwide.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
Dealing with operational problems arising during the daily running of communications and computer systems onboard vessels; Problem determination and resolution of issues reported by vessels experiencing hardware or operational problems.
  
  
Proactive Maintenance of existing equipment, hardware including networking equipment.
  
  
First line troubleshooting of communication issues and escalation to service providers.
  
  
Installation and configuration of new equipment (e.g. Servers, Firewalls, Switches, PCs, printers, etc.)
  
  
Managing helpdesk tickets and completing tasks allocated from the Helpdesk system.
  
  
Carry out cybersecurity audits, assessment and implement risk mitigation measures.
  
  
Respond to cybersecurity incidents reported by vessels and resolve and/or escalate as required.
  
  
System health checks.
  
  
Maintaining records of systems & vessels supported.
  
  
Communication of completed work Email / Phone support during weekends / public holidays
  
  
Any other tasks assigned by the Team Lead – Vessel Support, Head of IT Operations and Group IS Support Manager
  
  
You will provide support for critical vessel IT and communication issues during weekends and public holidays on a rotation basis.
  
  
**What can I expect in return?**
V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector - a company that has exciting plans for future growth.
  
  
**Essential**
Hands-on troubleshooting: Being able to quickly resolve technical issues with equipment, networks, or software in a high-pressure environment.
  
  
Knowledge of computer hardware, software, networking, and troubleshooting.
  
  
Familiarity with operating systems like Windows, Linux, and possibly others used on vessels.
  
  
Understanding of LAN (Local Area Network) and WAN (Wide Area Network), TCP/IP, VPNs, routers, and switches.
  
  
Familiarity with managing servers, databases, and onboard systems.
  
  
Basic understanding of network security, firewall configurations, and vulnerability management to protect the vessel's IT infrastructure.
  
  
**Desirable**
Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field such as:
  
  
Information Technology (IT)/ Computer Science/ Electrical/Electronics Engineering/ Maritime Engineering
  
  
Experience with maritime communication and navigation software such as satellite communication systems, ECDIS (Electronic Chart Display and Information
  
  
System), and AIS (Automatic Identification System).
  
  
Experience in IT support in a maritime or offshore environment, particularly in managing the specialised IT systems onboard ships or oil rigs.
  
  
Familiarity with the unique IT systems used on vessels, including communications systems (satellite, radio), onboard operational software, and bridge systems.
  
  
Certification in IT Support or Networking: Such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Cisco's CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) can be advantageous.
  
  
**Applications Close Date**

**SECTION IV: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & KPIS OF THE ROLE**
**Responsibilities**

* Core Responsibilities
* Drive proactive policy engagement with municipal corporations, state climate agencies, and nodal government bodies (e.g., BEE, MoEFCCC) to support formulation of new methodologies/ projects, facilitate the adoption of best practices and alignment with NDCs
* Development of a Decarbonization and Carbon Markets advisory offerings, and areas of opportunity so as to act as a bridge between evolving government climate mandates and MSME clients.
* Source advisory mandates and execute seamlessly in advising MSMEs and corporate clients on complex climate-impact related business barriers, (such as CBAM) in export markets and impending domestic climate rules /carbon markets
* Work on Policy-to-Action frameworks such as translating policy landscapes and national climate targets into actionable business strategies for clients, and opportunities for transition / green finance.
* Technical Excellence & Oversight support for MSMEs in emission measurement / reduction requirements, including best practices, aligning CCTS opportunities, GHG accounting, and carbon market readiness, and developing these into comprehensive business advisory solutions.
* Build an intelligence and advocacy network with industry associations, verification agencies, and market integrity bodies, institutions in the climate finance / blended finance ecosystem and sources of such capital, and provide clients with insights on shifts in rules and market developments.
* Knowledge champion to compile data analyzed into a specific sector to generate insightful, actionable knowledge aligned to clients’ areas of interest and business strategy and to lead sectoral initiatives and develop sector-specific insights, reports, event partnerships, policy advocacy and similar thought leadership
* Build own capabilities for deeper understanding of other sectors of focus for the team.

* Internal Communication, database management, reporting.
* Number of Advisory engagements

* Number of Knowledge Initiatives undertaken / Knowledge Reports/ Newsletters/ Knowledge Platforms

Domain Expertise:
  
  

* 5–10 years of experience in climate policy, carbon markets, GHG accounting, or decarbonization strategy, with deep knowledge of GHG Protocol, and preferably of other protocol such as CCTS methodologies, and global reporting frameworks.
* Proven ability to translate complex governmental NDCs and climate mandates into practical business strategies, specifically tailored to the operational realities of MSMEs and corporate clients.
* Technical Advisory Skills: Hands-on expertise in emissions quantification, baseline setting, and MRV (Measurement, Reporting, and Verification) workflows.
* Business Acumen: Strong understanding of the intersection between climate risk and corporate business objectives, including non-tariff trade barriers and export market dynamics.
* Past experience of offering support clients in preparing for both mandatory and voluntary carbon disclosures, including scope‑wise emissions assessment, activity data validation, EF application, uncertainty evaluation, and verification preparation. Experience advising corporates on emissions computation, mitigation pathways, climate risk, or transition planning.
* Stakeholder Navigation: Demonstrated experience in building and managing high-level relationships with industry associations and preferable experience with municipal/state-level government bodies, Nodal authorities.
* Scalable Advisory Design: Ability to develop and maintain inhouse advisory tools, calculation templates, and playbooks to enable scalable service delivery across diverse sectors.
* Communication & Influence: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the capacity to influence senior stakeholders and provide clear, strategic guidance to clients navigating the climate transition.
* Execution Focus: Proven capability to operate with high independence, managing multiple advisory assignments under tight deadlines with extreme attention to detail and data integrity.
* Preferable hands‑on exposure to emissions quantification, emission factor (EF) selection, baseline formula application, MRV workflows, and corporate GHG inventory building and emissions baselining, aligned with Indian regulatory requirements, CCTS methodologies, and global standards (GHG Protocol).
* Deep understand of approaches to Net-Zero framework and goals.
* Ability to building working relationships with clients and work under tight deadlines
* Excellent communication, interpersonal skills and teamwork
* Computing skills – Advanced skills in MS Office, Excel, Power point and use of consulting related tools, databases
* Highly customer focused, with high level of integrity and attention to detail

Economics / Engineering /Environmental Science background

title: SEO Medical Content Writer
description:
**Company:** 
 Healthus.ai
 



**Department:** 
 Content \& SEO
 



**Location:** 
 Bandra, Mumbai
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 2\-5 years in health or medical content writing with demonstrable SEO results
   




 About the Role
 
 Healthus.ai builds organic visibility for hospitals, clinics, specialists, and healthcare brands. As a Medical SEO Content Writer, you will write search\-optimised content that ranks, earns patient trust, and drives appointments, while staying clinically accurate, ethically compliant, and aligned with Google's standards for health content (E\-E\-A\-T and YMYL). You will work with SEO strategists, designers, and clinician reviewers across multiple healthcare client accounts.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Content creation** 



* Write service pages, condition and treatment pages, procedure explainers, FAQs, blogs, doctor profile pages, and location/landing pages for hospitals and clinics.
* Cover content across the patient journey: symptom awareness, diagnosis, treatment options, cost and recovery, and appointment decision.
* Turn complex clinical information into plain language at a reading level suited to patients, without losing accuracy.
* Write meta titles, meta descriptions, header structure, internal link anchors, and schema\-ready FAQ blocks.



**2\. SEO execution** 



* Conduct keyword research and intent mapping (informational, commercial, local, transactional) using tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Keyword Planner, and Search Console.
* Build content briefs and outlines based on SERP analysis, competitor gaps, and People Also Ask data.
* Optimise existing content: refresh outdated pages, fix cannibalisation, improve CTR and rankings.
* Support local SEO: Google Business Profile posts, service\-area and city pages, and NAP consistency.
* Optimise for AI search surfaces (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) through clear answer\-first structure, entity coverage, and citable facts.



**3\. Medical accuracy and compliance** 



* Source claims from credible references: peer\-reviewed journals, PubMed, WHO, ICMR, NHS, CDC, Mayo Clinic, and specialty societies.
* Route content through the doctor or clinical reviewer workflow and incorporate feedback precisely.
* Follow healthcare advertising rules, including the Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, NMC guidelines on doctor advertising, and Indian consumer and privacy regulations, plus HIPAA/GDPR awareness for international clients.
* Never make guaranteed\-cure claims, unverified outcome claims, or testimonial\-based medical promises.
* Add disclaimers, reviewer credits, "last reviewed" dates, and citations as per client and Google guidelines.



**4\. Performance and reporting** 



* Track rankings, organic traffic, impressions, CTR, conversions, and appointment\-led metrics for assigned content.
* Share monthly insights with recommendations for updates and new topics.
* Maintain a content calendar and meet deadlines across multiple clients.



**5\. Collaboration** 



* Work with SEO, design, development, and account teams on page implementation.
* Interview doctors and hospital marketing teams to gather insights and unique experience signals.
* Keep brand voice consistent per client.



  




 Required Qualifications
 * Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Biotechnology, Journalism, English, or a related field (a medical background is a strong plus).
* 2\-5 years writing health or medical content for the web, ideally for an agency, hospital, or healthtech brand.
* Working knowledge of on\-page SEO: keyword mapping, header hierarchy, internal linking, schema basics, and search intent.
* Strong command of English, with clean, error\-free, original writing.
* Ability to read and interpret clinical studies and guidelines.
* Portfolio of published medical content with ranking or traffic results.



  




 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience in specialities such as IVF, oncology, orthopaedics, cardiology, dermatology, dentistry, or cosmetic surgery.
* Familiarity with the Google Search Quality Rater Guidelines and the YMYL framework.
* Experience with GA4, Search Console, Surfer SEO, Clearscope, or Frase.
* Basic WordPress skills.
* Additional language skills (Hindi, Marathi, Arabic) for multilingual healthcare content.
* Experience writing for international markets (US, UK, UAE, Singapore).



  




 Skills and Competencies
 * Precision: you do not change dosages, statistics, or clinical terms without verifying them.
* Research depth: you can brief yourself on an unfamiliar condition within hours.
* Empathy in tone for sensitive topics such as cancer, fertility, and mental health.
* Responsible use of AI writing tools, with every draft fact\-checked and humanised before submission.
* Receptiveness to clinician feedback and revision cycles.



  




 Standards We Hold
 * Zero tolerance for plagiarism and AI\-generated content that hasn't been verified.
* Every medical claim must be traceable to a credible source.
* Content must serve the patient first and the keyword second.

 EisnerAmper, a premier accounting and business advisory services firm, seeks a Website Coordinator to join our team. + Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**What Work You Will Be Responsible For**

* Website Quality \& Performance

* Manage website\-generated leads in the firm’s CRM and reporting tools, including data entry, tracking, and record maintenance, with accuracy and timely updates.
* SEO Analysis
* Work with our SEO Manager to implement on\-page SEO best practices, including metadata optimization, header structure, internal linking, image optimization, and page performance improvements
* Assist with keyword alignment, content updates, and optimization initiatives based on SEO recommendations
* Support foundational keyword research and competitive analysis to identify content gaps, optimization opportunities, and areas of growth


**Basic Qualifications**

* General understanding of SEO and emerging AI search practices such as AEO and GEO.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to multi\-task
* Ability to manage multiple updates and deadlines
* Excellent communication and time management skills.
* Knowledge of Adobe creative suite (Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign) preferred.
* Although not a requirement, a degree in design, marketing or a relevant field is preferred.
* 2\+ years of experience in web operations, digital marketing, or related field.


 We strongly believe in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, EisnerAmper is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or protected veteran status, citizenship, or other protected characteristics under federal, state, or local law.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper**
 EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 5,000 employees and more than 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
   

  

 Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start\-ups, global public firms, and middle\-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not\-for\-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper India**
 EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non\-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees.  EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007\. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Ahmedabad, Bangalore and Hyderabad. title: Manager – Founders Office
description:
**About Glide Brands**




 Glide Brands is a growth\-focused business group building and scaling consumer and B2B brands across categories. The group has built businesses around brands such as
 **The Face Shop, Belif, Dyson and VoltaLux in India** 
 , and continues to build new brands, products and technology\-led businesses. We are looking for a highly driven
 **Manager – Founders Office** 
 who will work closely with the Founders on building technology products, AI\-powered automation and new digital capabilities across the Group.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is a
 **high\-ownership, hands\-on role** 
 at the intersection of
 **AI, technology, business and strategy** 
 . The candidate will work directly with the Founders to identify opportunities where technology and AI can improve the way the organisation operates, and then help
 **design, build, test and deploy practical solutions** 
 . This is not a traditional strategy or reporting role. We are looking for someone who can
 **think like a business problem solver and build like a technologist.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. AI \& Automation Projects** 



* Identify repetitive and inefficient business processes that can be automated using AI and technology.
* Build AI\-powered workflows and automation solutions across HR, Sales, Marketing, Finance, SCM and Operations.
* Work with LLMs, AI agents, APIs, automation platforms and Python\-based tools.
* Experiment rapidly with emerging AI technologies and convert useful ideas into working solutions.
* Measure the impact of automation through productivity, cost and efficiency improvements.



**2\. Technology Product Development** 



* Work with Founders to conceptualise and build internal technology products and business tools.
* Convert business requirements into product requirements, workflows and functional specifications.
* Develop prototypes/MVPs rapidly and take successful concepts towards deployment.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external technology partners wherever required.
* Own projects from
 **problem identification → solution design → development → testing → implementation** 
 .



**3\. Python \& AI Development** 



* Use Python for automation, data processing, integrations and AI applications.
* Build scripts, tools and APIs to connect different business systems.
* Work with AI/LLM APIs and develop practical AI\-enabled applications.
* Explore technologies such as RAG, AI agents, workflow automation and intelligent assistants.
* Integrate technology platforms using APIs wherever required.



**4\. Founders Office Projects** 



* Work directly with the Founders on strategic and technology\-led initiatives.
* Conduct rapid research on emerging technologies, products and business models.
* Analyse business problems and develop technology\-led solutions.
* Prepare concise business cases, product documents and implementation plans.
* Drive cross\-functional projects with speed and high ownership.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* **MBA/PGDM from a premium institute** 
 such as IIM / ISB / IIT or equivalent.
* Engineering / Computer Science / Technology background is strongly preferred.
* **2–5 years of experience** 
 in technology consulting, product, AI, automation, analytics, startup or digital transformation roles.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with
 **Python** 
 .
* Experience building
 **AI automation projects** 
 is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of
 **LLMs, APIs, AI tools and automation platforms** 
 .
* Ability to build prototypes rather than only create presentations.



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 We are looking for someone who can say:
 



**“Give me the business problem. I will understand it, figure out the technology, build a prototype and make it work.”** 




 The ideal candidate combines the
 **strategic thinking of a management consultant, the technical curiosity of a product engineer and the execution speed of a startup professional.** 




 What You Will Get
 


* Direct exposure to the
 **Founders and senior leadership** 
 .
* Opportunity to work on real\-world
 **AI and technology transformation projects** 
 .
* Freedom to experiment with the latest AI technologies.
* Exposure across
 **strategy, technology, AI, product and business operations** 
 .



  





**Key Skills** 




**Mandatory:** 



* Python
* AI / Generative AI
* Automation
* Problem Solving
* Product Thinking
* APIs / Integrations
* Advanced Excel / Data Analysis



  





**Preferred:** 



* LLM APIs
* AI Agents
* RAG
* LangChain / LangGraph or similar frameworks
* n8n / Make / Zapier or similar automation platforms
* SQL
* Git / GitHub
* Cloud platforms
* Web application development



  





**Success in This Role** 




 Success will be measured by the candidate's ability to
 **identify high\-value opportunities, rapidly build technology solutions and create measurable improvements in the way Glide Brands operates.** 




**If you are someone who enjoys building things with AI and technology—not just talking about them—this role is for you.**

**Location:**

title: National Technical Manager - LAP
description:
**About Credit Saison India**
**Established in 2019, Credit Saison India (CS India) is one of the country’s fastest\-growing Non\-Bank Financial Company (NBFC) lenders, with a mission to meet India’s huge gap for credit among underserved segments. Registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and boasting an “
 **AAA** 
 ” rating from CRISIL and CARE Ratings, CS India operates a tech\-enabled model facilitating lending at scale. With a branch network of 80\+ physical offices, 2\.06 million active loans, and an AUM of over US$2B, we are committed to being a transformative partner for MSMEs, households, and individuals. It ensures that aggressive financial inclusion is supported by asset\-quality safeguards, protecting the institution’s capital and reputation as it scales further.**
****Position Purpose****
**The National Technical Manager is responsible for developing and implementing the technical valuation framework across the organization to ensure accurate property valuation, legal compliance, risk mitigation, and standardization of technical processes. The role is critical in maintaining portfolio quality while supporting business growth through timely and consistent technical assessments across our expanding pan\-India network. Standardized technical assessments directly mitigate the risk of Non\-Performing Assets (NPAs) by ensuring that loan values are tied to verified, high\-quality collateral rather than market speculation. This rigor is the primary driver behind maintaining a low\-risk profile, which in turn sustains the organization’s prestigious “
 **AAA** 
 ” rating. Executing this vision requires a sophisticated governance structure capable of translating high\-level policy into field\-level execution.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Technical Policy \& Governance


 Defining Technical Eligibility Is The First Line Of Defence In Mitigating Collateral Risk Within The Home Loan And Loan Against Property (LAP) Segments. By Setting Clear Benchmarks, CS India Ensures That The Collateral Remains Marketable And Legally Enforceable Throughout The Loan Tenure. Acceptable Standards Must Be Categorized To Address The Unique Risks Of Different Lending Segments
   

  

* Affordable and Prime LAP: Focused on building age, structural stability, and resale marketability.
* Home Loans/Affordable Housing: Emphasizing NHB compliance and the structural integrity of residential units.
* MSME\-linked Collateral: Specialized assessment of industrial sheds, mixed\-use properties, and commercial viability, which carry distinct risks compared to residential assets.
* Commercial Property: Evaluating industrial construction standards and occupancy potential. Technical Risk Guidelines must be developed to address:
* Structural Integrity: Verifying building materials and age to ensure the property outlasts the loan tenure.
* Legal \& Municipal Alignment: Strict adherence to RERA provisions and local building codes to prevent demolition or legal stay orders.
* Product\-Specific Risks: Differentiating risk parameters (e.g., higher depreciation for industrial MSME sheds vs. prime residential).
* Compliance Benchmarks: Define acceptable construction and property standards. Serving as a "Go/No\-Go" checklist for field teams, ensuring transparency in property selection. These standards establish the benchmarks that both internal teams and external partners must satisfy during the appraisal process.
* Standardize valuation methodologies across all regions, as well as prepare technical risk guidelines for various products, and introduce best industry practices and regulatory requirements.
* Vendor Management


**Required**
**Outsourced valuations present inherent strategic risks, including potential collusion, valuation inflation, and operational delays. A rigorous vendor governance lifecycle is required to ensure external agencies operate with the same integrity as internal staff. The end\-to\-end Vendor Management process includes:**
* Empanel and onboard technical valuers nationwide, based on capability, reputation, and regional expertise, with their comprehensive background checks and performance history.
* Negotiate commercial terms with valuation agencies, and align fees with quality and turnaround expectations.
* Conduct due diligence and periodic performance reviews. Quarterly cycles to monitor accuracy, compliance and TAT.
* Having a process of identifying and systematic purging of underperformers; vendors who fail to meet accuracy benchmarks or exhibit unethical behavior are blacklisted to protect the lending lifecycle from fraudulent or incompetent reporting.
* Technical Appraisal \& Due Diligence


**Consistency in methodology prevents property valuations from being skewed by temporary market bubbles. For high\-value and complex proposals, the framework mandates an escalation matrix to ensure that senior technical leadership reviews exceptional cases. Details for the critical risk factors validated during the appraisal process are: Appraisal Component, Critical Risk Factor to Validate, Property Eligibility, Boundary disputes, non\-permissible land use, or title\-technical mismatches, Technical Compliance, FSI/FAR violations, lack of Occupancy Certificates (OC), or non\-adherence to approved plans, Valuation Assumptions, Validity of "Market Rate" vs. "Realizable Value" and excessive depreciation adjustments, Exceptional Cases, High\-risk deviations from standard technical norms or construction quality issues, etc.**
* Validate valuation assumptions and ensure property eligibility as per policy.
* Review high\-value and complex property proposals.
* Guide field technical teams on difficult cases.
* Approve exceptional technical cases.
* Portfolio Risk Management \& Quality Assurance


 Transitioning From Transaction\-level Reviews To Macro\-level Analytics Is Critical For Institutional Stability. This Framework Focuses On "Variance Analysis" — The Delta Between Vendor Valuations And Internal Check\-valuations — As a Core Tool For Identifying Systemic Inflation Or Fraud. The Technical Risk Mitigation Strategy Includes
   

  

* Monitoring for valuation inflation trends and identifying rogue patterns that necessitate the blacklisting of valuers.
* Identifying clusters of construction quality issues or rapid valuation shifts in specific micro\-markets.
* Conducting periodic technical audits and re\-inspections to verify vendor findings.
* Monitor technical fraud indicators and identify valuation inflation trends.
* Conduct portfolio analytics and recommend corrective actions.
* Conduct periodic technical audits and review valuation quality.
* Develop and periodically review Technical Valuation Policy.
* Process Improvement \& Technology Integration
* Developing precise guardrails to safeguard the portfolio against substandard construction and legal non\-compliance.
* Reduce Technical TAT, automate workflows, and digitize valuation reports.
* Develop technical manuals and organize knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Introduce GIS, geo\-tagging, and image analytics wherever feasible.
* Work with IT teams for LOS/LMS integration.
* Support AI\-enabled valuation initiatives.
* Team Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Coordination


**Socializing by training Regional Technical Managers, conducting mandatory certification programs, and developing comprehensive Technical Manuals to ensure knowledge management is institutionalized. This function must be led by an executive with a B.E./B.Tech (or Diploma) in Civil Engineering and 12–18 years of experience in technical valuation and mortgage lending.**
* Manage a technical team for affordable LAP, Prime LAP and Home Loans.
* Coordinate closely with Credit, Sales, Operations, Legal, Collections, Risk, Product, and IT.
* Periodic reviews of the Technical Valuation Policy to reflect shifting macroeconomic and real estate trends.
* Unifying valuation approaches across diverse geographic regions and product lines.
* Regulatory Compliance \& Governance


 Managing a Decentralized Network Of Over 80 Physical Offices Necessitates a Centralized Governance Model To Prevent Inconsistent Risk Applications. Centralized Oversight Ensures That a Property Valued In Mumbai Follows The Same Rigorous Standards As One In a Tier\-3 Town, Shielding The National Portfolio From Localized Volatility And Substandard Construction. The Mandate For Technical Policy \& Governance Includes
   

  

* Ensure compliance with RBI Guidelines, NHB Guidelines (for HFCs), RERA provisions, and Municipal regulations.
* Address Internal Audit requirements and Risk Committee observations.
* Ensuring the technical function provides robust documentation as well as data for Internal Audits, RBI inspections, and statutory audits, maintaining the transparency required for an AAA\-rated entity. Technology is the primary vehicle for automating these monitoring and mitigation functions at scale.


****Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)****
* Business: Technical TAT, Valuation turnaround time, Vendor productivity, Technical approval rate.
* Risk: Technical fraud cases, Portfolio valuation variance, Audit observations, Construction quality issues, Policy deviation percentage.
* Operational: Vendor turnaround time, Reinspection completion, Report accuracy, Technical rejection ratio.


****Decision Making Authority****
* Approve technical vendors and recommend policy changes.
* Approve technical deviations within delegated authority.
* Escalate high\-risk cases and recommend blacklisting of valuers.


****Candidate Profile****
**Educational Qualification**
* Mandatory: B.E./B.Tech (Civil Engineering) / Diploma in Civil Engineering


**Experience \& Skills**
* 12–18 years of experience in Technical Valuation, Mortgage Lending, Housing Finance, or NBFC.
* Minimum 5 years managing a zonal/national technical function.
* Experience in Loan Against Property (LAP), Home Loans (HL), Affordable Housing, and Commercial Property valuations.
* Exposure to policy formulation and vendor management.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to balance risk control with business enablement.

title: Technical Writer (No AI Writing, Human Content Only)
description:
**This is not a typical content role.** 




 If your instinct is to:
 


* Use ChatGPT to write content
* Optimize for speed over quality
* Follow templates without thinking



 This role is not for you.
 



  





**About Perfect Clicks LLC \- Based In New Jersey, USA** 




  





 Perfect Clicks is a performance\-driven SEO and digital marketing company focused on one core mission: creating irreplaceable, human\-written content that dominates Google rankings and becomes a source for AI systems. We don’t chase trends or shortcuts. We build long\-term digital assets through deep research, structured thinking, and high\-quality execution. Our work spans SEO, content strategy, branding, and full\-funnel marketing, all tied to measurable results including rankings, traffic, and revenue growth. With over a decade of experience, hundreds of brands served, and thousands of top\-ranking keywords, we operate as strategic partners—not vendors—helping businesses scale through content that compounds over time and cannot be replicated by AI. 
 



  





 We work with high\-traffic financial platforms, e\-commerce brands, media companies, startups, agencies, and enterprise clients. Since SEO content is the foundation of our business's marketing deliverables, you'll be responsible for writing high quality blog posts, articles, and case studies for a wide range of niches, including wealth management, hospitality, music therapy, pain management, finance, construction, food and restaurants, and more.
 



  





 We do not:
 


* Produce generic SEO content
* Use AI to write blogs
* Optimize for volume



  





 We do:
 


* Create specific, technical, value\-driven content
* Build real expertise through human\-created work
* Develop team members into strategic partners — not just writers



  





**The Role: Technical Writer** 




  





 As a technical writer with a focus in SEO strategy, you will start by writing — but this is not a traditional writing role.
 



 Writing is how you:
 


* Learn industries deeply
* Understand client businesses
* Develop strategic thinking



  





 This role is designed as a structured path from execution to strategy, where content writing is the foundation, not the end goal. You will begin by writing and contributing directly to client work, learning how to research, think, and produce high\-quality content that drives real SEO performance. As you develop, you will move from task\-based execution to owning outcomes—understanding client goals, analyzing data, and contributing to strategy. Over time, high performers transition into leadership roles, managing projects, guiding team members, and participating in client decision\-making. With a clear progression from training to independent contribution to strategic direction, this role is built to develop long\-term thinkers who can grow into executive\-level responsibilities within 6 months to 3 years based on performance and ownership.
 



  





**LOCATION:** 
 Virtual
 



**HOURS:** 
 8:30 AM EST to 5 PM EST (6 PM to 2:30 AM)
 



**SALARY:** 
 6 to 10 LPA
 



  





**Career Growth Path (Year 1\):** 




**Bootcamp Phase (0\-1 month)** 




 Intensive training focused on writing, research, and core frameworks. You will learn how to produce high\-quality, manual content, understand industries deeply, and build the foundation for strategic thinking. This phase is about learning how to think, not just execute.
 



**Core Team (1\-6 months)** 




 Transition into a full contributor role, owning content production and taking responsibility for quality, timelines, and communication. You will begin making independent decisions, improving efficiency, and developing a deeper understanding of client goals and SEO performance.
 



**Lead Team (6\-12\+ months)** 




 Move into strategy and leadership, managing projects, guiding team members, and contributing to client direction. You will take ownership of outcomes, including content performance, growth, and long\-term strategy, while mentoring others and helping scale operations.
 



  





 The goal is to become someone clients trust to make decisions and become a leader on our team, not just write blogs.
 



  





**Core Beliefs on AI Content vs. Human Content** 




  





 No generative AI tools for writing content.
 


* No ChatGPT
* No Gemini or Claude
* No AI\-generated drafts



  





*If AI can write your content, you are not adding value.* 




  





 AI\-generated content leads to generic output, weak differentiation, and poor long\-term performance. Our goal is to create content that AI cannot replicate, only reference.
 



  




* **AI\-generated writing is not allowed \-** 
 We maintain a zero\-tolerance policy for AI\-written content. It goes against our standards, our values, and the level of quality we expect.
* **AI content does not create value \-** 
 AI\-generated content is easy to produce, but also easy to replace. It lacks originality, depth, and true expertise—making it ineffective for long\-term SEO performance and client growth.
* **Human content is what AI depends on \-** 
 AI systems do not create knowledge—they aggregate it. The only content that holds value is original, human\-created insight that AI can reference and learn from.
* **We aim to be the source, not the output \-** 
 Our goal is to create content that ranks on Google and is used in AI Overviews, ChatGPT responses, and other AI systems—not content that competes with them.
* **AI usage reduces learning and expertise \-** 
 Relying on AI shortcuts limits your ability to think, analyze, and develop real skill. Manual work builds knowledge. AI dependence prevents it.



  





**What You’ll Actually Do** 



* Write 1–2 high\-quality blog posts daily using Perfect Clicks internal frameworks
* Translate complex information into clear, structured, user\-focused content
* Conduct SEO keyword research and analysis for client sites
* Continuously refine content based on feedback and performance
* Communicate proactively with a remote team working US hours
* Contribute to long\-term content strategy as you grow



  





**Brands, Topics, \& Industries** 




 You will work across a wide range of brands and industries, including:
 


* Medical and healthcare services and procedures
* Pain management, regenerative medicine, minimally invasive surgeries
* Construction and local service industries (projects, pricing, materials)
* E\-commerce and consumer products (comparisons, positioning, conversion content)
* Forex broker platforms, proprietary trading firms, and wealth management companies
* Financial markets: bonds, commodities, cryptocurrencies, stock CFDs, ETFs, indices, options
* Trading strategies, platform features, and investment analysis
* B2B SaaS platforms, software tools, and product workflows



  





**Benefits** 



* Paid sick time
* Pain vacation time
* Paid holidays
* Flexible unpaid time off



  





**We are not looking for:** 




  




* Generic SEO writers
* People who want easy, repetitive work
* Candidates who rely on AI tools



  





**We are looking for:** 




  





**Quality\-First Thinkers \-** 
 You get frustrated by generic content, care about doing things properly, and notice when something is off.
 



**Methodical Learners** 
 \- You ask questions before starting, want to understand why, and take time to do things right.
 



**High Ownership Individuals** 
 \- You communicate proactively, do not cut corners, and take responsibility for outcomes.
 



**Long\-Term Builders** 
 \- You want to develop real skills, grow into strategy, and are willing to do hard things now for long\-term growth.
 



  





**Who Should Not Apply** 



* You prefer using AI tools for writing
* You prioritize speed over quality
* You struggle with detailed feedback
* You avoid asking questions
* You want quick, low\-effort work



  





**Why This Role Is Different** 




 Most companies want more content, faster, and use AI to scale output. We are doing the opposite.
 



 We believe the future belongs to people who think first, not people who prompt first.
 



  





**Growth and Opportunity** 



* Direct mentorship and structured feedback
* Clear path from execution to strategy
* Opportunity to work closely with leadership
* Long\-term role for high performers



  





**Remote Work** 



* Fully remote
* Must be comfortable working US hours (8:30 AM – 5 PM EST / 6 PM – 2:30 AM IST)
* Strong communication is required



  





**Qualifications** 



* Excellent English writing, grammar, and communication skills
* 3\+ years of experience in content writing, journalism, or a related field
* Ability to break down complex financial or technical topics
* Strong research, analytical, and problem\-solving skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Ability to work independently and collaborate in a remote environment
* Positive, accountable, and growth\-oriented mindset



  





**Hiring Process** 




 Our hiring process is designed to identify thinking ability, alignment with our philosophy, and communication and ownership.
 



 You will go through:
 


1. Large Format Group Introduction Call (30 min)
2. Assessment For Values \& Vision Alignment (15 min)
3. Technical Round To Evaluate Content Writing (90 min)



 We are highly selective. Most candidates do not pass.
 



  





**Keywords** 




 SEO Content Writing, Copywriting, Communications, Digital Marketing, Content Strategist, Content Marketing, B2B SaaS Content, Blog Writing, Keyword Research, Content Strategy, Organic Growth, Technical Writing, Content Optimization, Remote Content Jobs, Content Specialist, Marketing Content Writer, Remote Writing Jobs
 



  





**How To Apply** 




 If you have read this entire post carefully, include the word “SEO FIRST” in your application.
 



 Apply with intention.
 


* This is not an easy role, but for the right person, it is a career\-defining opportunity.

title: Senior HazCom Specialist
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About you and the role:**
 The EH\&S teams are committed to protecting people and the planet by delivering Product Safety services for more than 6,000 Dow products. To strengthen Hazard Communication (HazCom) services, we are seeking a
 **Senior HazCom Specialist** 
 based in Navi Mumbai, India, or São Paulo, Brazil, or Terneuzen, the Netherlands. In this role, you will develop and implement tools, templates, and work processes that support the cost\-effective creation of compliant safety data sheets (SDSs) and labels across Dow’s markets, advise on SDS requirements, hazard classification, and substances of concern in Dow products, and provide regulatory intelligence support across businesses.
   

  

**Responsibilities / Duties**
 As Senior HazCom Specialist, you will implement expert rules to automate the creation of selected SDS sections. You will also lead projects—including SAP system updates—to meet regulatory requirements such as national GHS implementations, Poison Centre Notification requirements, and other reporting obligations.
   

  

* You will work autonomously within established work\-process boundaries and clearly communicate complex matters involving dependencies across teams.
* Develop and implement complex tools, templates and work processes documentation (HazCom standards, job aids, swim lanes, etc.) to comply with Hazard Communication regulatory requirements and company standards. This includes: Safety Data Sheets, EH\&S content for Labels, notification to C\&L regional Inventories, etc.)
* Deliver expertise, develop complex technical training and coaching on HazCom work processes and tools (ERP Systems) across Dow functions and businesses.
* Represent the function during internal and external audits and inspections
* Scan, interpret and implement complex HazCom regulations
* Support complex regional advocacy activities and initiatives on HazCom subjects.
* Lead Hazard Communication expertise for EH\&S Product Regulatory global matters (leverages beyond the work group) including ERP system updates and upgrades
* Lead improvement in small projects in existing global work process processes and tools
* Lead complex compliance issue resolution. Support EHS\&S Integrated Services in resolution.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Master's degree in chemistry, Toxicology Engineering, or related fields
* 3\-5 years' experience in the field of product safety/hazard communication. This includes GHS classification requirements
* Knowledge of SAP EH\&S Module is a plus


**Your Skills**
* Analytical, detailed oriented, problem\-solving thinking
* Excellent communication skills
* Customer’s oriented mindset
* Data mining proficiency is a plus


**Additional Notes**
* Relocation assistance is not available with this position.
* The ability to accommodate flexible schedule aligned with international time Zone is essential.


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
   

  

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company\-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial\-goals.
+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.

* On\-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.

+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)


 Join our team, we can make a difference together.

 Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer\-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges.  Track\-specific strengths help: coordination and planning (Project Management), writing and social media (Marketing), confidence in conversation and persistence (Sales).

 live enterprise client work from week one

 Executive cadre at ₹3\.6–4\.5 LPA on confirmation

 guidance from senior managers and exposure to the tools and processes of a global language services business

 clients across life sciences, automotive, manufacturing, legal and technology
