**Analytical Skills:** 
 Strong analytical capabilities to interpret clinical data, evaluate assay performance, understand laboratory workflows and guidelines like CLSI, ASHI, WHO, NABL/CAP accreditation etc.
 



**Troubleshooting Skills:** 
 Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot application\-related issues, perform
 **root\-cause analysis** 
 , identify corrective actions, and coordinate effectively with technical/service teams to resolve customer challenges.
 



**Communication \& Training:** 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with laboratory professionals, pathologists, clinicians, internal stakeholders, and customers. Ability to deliver effective
 **product/application training, presentations, and technical documentation** 
 .
 



**Technical Support:** 
 Hands\-on capability in providing technical and application support for
 **clinical flow cytometers, sample preparation systems, and associated software** 
 . Experience with laboratory diagnostics instrumentation will be an advantage.
 



**Industry Experience:** 
 Experience in
 **clinical laboratories, diagnostic companies, IVD organizations, or healthcare technology companies** 
 will be preferred.
 



**Customer Engagement:** 
 Ability to understand customer requirements, provide application\-focused solutions, support demonstrations and evaluations, and contribute to successful implementation of clinical flow cytometry solutions.
 



**Mobility \& Work Location:** 
 Ability to work in a
 **hybrid setup from Delhi or Kolkata** 
 , with flexibility to travel outstation at customer sites as required.
 



**Collaboration:** 
 Ability to work effectively with
 **Application, Sales, Service, Product Management, Marketing, and other cross\-functional teams** 
 to deliver comprehensive customer solutions.

title: NY Equity Documentation(ISDA),Vice President, Institutional Equity Division
description:
NY Equity Documentation Group , Vice President, Institutional Equity Division
   

  

 This role is in Mumbai and requires working with the NY Equity Documentation Group based in New York. The role will require a fast\-learning, dynamic, pro\-active, and self\-motivated person to assist the team in its day\-to\-day activities.
   

  

 The current opening is for a professional within the NY team based in Mumbai, with responsibility for documentation aspects of OTC derivative transactions, prime brokerage, cash and stock\-lending transactions in the NY region.
   

  

 Institutional Securities Documentation (ISD) is a global team based in several locations (including New York, London, Hong Kong, and Tokyo). The NY equity documentation group is part of global ISD and is comprised of a group of negotiators with legal backgrounds (i.e. practicing lawyers in HK/UK/NY; and/or as holders of law degrees/master’s in law). Within the NY IED we are part of the risk function and we support the equity businesses and handle documentation for prime brokerage and listed derivatives, over\-the\-counter on equity swaps/options (vanilla and exotic) on global equity underlying, stock\-lending, warrants issuance, cash trading, equity research, regulatory remediation and subsets of documentation relating to our coverage areas.
   

  

 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales \& Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED, associated to sales, trading, analytics, strats, risk management and documentation.
   

  

**What You'll Do In The Role**
* Manage the team of lawyers on the ground, co\-ordinate with stakeholder on team dynamics, work management and allocations. Grooming/ training of team
* Draft, negotiate and execute (including amendments to) master derivatives agreements, including but not limited to ISDA, VM CSA, IM CSA, equity swaps /options and prime brokerage related documentation.
* Review and analyze constitutional documents of the client, to establish their capacity and authority capabilities for entering derivative transactions with Morgan Stanley.
* Review and analyze capacity and authority legal opinion from external counsel and highlight issues to Risk and Legal for approvals where applicable.
* Work closely with MS internal stakeholders, to obtain approvals on deviated terms identified in negotiable agreements, with clear implication on deviated terms to enable internal stakeholders to make informed decisions.
* Handle business unit’s queries on the terms of documentation ISD handles.
* Participate in globally or locally led projects related to documentation requirements.
* Undertake tasks directly related to the coordination and lifecycle management of the clients’ agreements and act as the primary point of contact for the clients for all tasks originating from the NY region.
* Responsible for administering and facilitating the agreement execution process; maintain and update clients’ contract database/systems; attend to day\-to\-day coordination among internal procurement and legal teams with respect to such contracts; and perform due diligence to ensure contract terms and conditions as well as information of the parties is reflected in the client’s contract database/systems.


**What You'll Bring To The Role**
* Law graduate with relevant 13\+ years of experience in financing/derivatives is preferred.
* Experience in team management will be preferred.
* In\-house documentation negotiation experience or paralegal experience in corporate law firm is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Prepared to speak to clients (internal and external) at all times.
* Proficiency in English is a must. Good team player with potential to lead a team.
* Solid quantitative skills and strong interest in business, economics, and law.
* Willingness and ability to provide quality service to the Firm's clients and to promote and enhance the Firm franchise.
* Willingness to work in dynamic environment and the ability to excel under pressure.
* Proficiency and interest in technology and systems development.
* Organized, pro\-active, ability to multi\-task and work efficiently, detail\-oriented, and self\-sufficient.


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

**About You On This Role**
 We are committed to delivering fast, accurate, and customer\-centric support that helps customers confidently navigate product safety, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 As a
 **Product Stewardship Specialist** 
 , you will play a critical role in ensuring the safe and compliant use of our products by addressing Environmental, Health \& Safety (EH\&S) and regulatory inquiries from customers and internal stakeholders. This position sits at the intersection of customer care, product stewardship, and regulatory compliance, requiring strong collaboration, analytical thinking, and effective communication. The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer\-focused, and experienced in regulatory and compliance\-related topics. You will thrive in a dynamic, multinational environment by effectively managing priorities, analyzing data, tracking progress, and partnering with global teams to deliver timely and accurate solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer Environmental, Health \& Safety (EH\&S) and regulatory inquiries, providing timely and accurate responses while engaging subject matter experts when required.
* Manage and track customer inquiries through internal systems, ensuring proper documentation, timely follow\-up, and resolution of high\-priority requests.
* Execute established escalation processes for complex regulatory, toxicology, RDS statement, and product communication requests to ensure customer needs are addressed effectively.
* Analyze inquiry trends and collaborate with Enterprise Product Stewardship Services (PSS) teams to enhance self\-service resources, streamline processes, and improve customer experience.
* Prioritize workload based on business requirements, customer expectations, and real\-time performance metrics to maintain service excellence.
* Support EH\&S data harmonization initiatives, maintain compliance\-related documentation, and deliver training and guidance to customer\-facing teams on EH\&S information management and regulatory requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Environmental Science, Toxicology, Industrial Hygiene, Product Stewardship, Product Regulatory Affairs, Sustainability, or related EH\&S discipline.
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience in Product Stewardship, Regulatory Affairs, EH\&S, or a related function.
* Strong knowledge of global regulatory frameworks, products, and markets, preferably within Silicone products and applications for Home \& Personal Care industries.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel; SAP experience is considered an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.


**Your Skills**
* Strong customer\-focused mindset with a passion for delivering accurate, timely, and high\-quality support.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously expand knowledge in chemistry, silicone products, and global regulatory requirements.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across technical, commercial, and global teams.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to work independently and make sound business decisions. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and draw meaningful conclusions.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills across multiple functions and geographies.
* Solution\-oriented approach with a focus on continuous improvement and efficient problem\-solving. Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment.

* This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with global product stewardship professionals, technical experts, and business teams while supporting customers across multiple regions.

* This role provides exposure to international regulatory frameworks and the opportunity to contribute to the safe and sustainable use of Dow products worldwide.

title: Manager - L&D Content Development
description:
**Role Details:**




**Designation** 
 : Manager
 



**Function:** 
 Human Resources \| Department: L\&D
 



**Reports to:** 
 Director Talent Engagement and Development
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Lower Parel)
 



**Span:** 
 Central L\&D
 



**Experience:** 
 8 – 10 years
 



  





**Role Overview:**




 The Manager \- Content Development designs and builds the learning content used across BDO India. The role turns learning needs into structured, usable content for leadership, behavioural and AI programmes, spanning e\-learning, workshop material, learning resources and assessments. It owns the content design standard every Service Line Academy follows and helps academy experts turn what they know into well designed learning.
 



  





**Key accountabilities:**




**Instructional design:** 



* Turn a learning need into clear objectives, a design and a storyboard, using an established approach such as ADDIE or SAM, and Bloom's Taxonomy to pitch each objective at the right level.
* Design blended learning journeys for the leadership tracks alongside the Leadership and Behavioural Trainers.
* Work with subject matter experts, business leads and HR to draw out raw knowledge and break it into simple, bite sized learning components.



**Content production:** 



* Build e\-learning content: interactive modules, microlearning, video and job aids for self\-paced learning.
* Build workshop content: instructor led decks, facilitator guides, playbooks, participant workbooks and activity material for classroom and virtual sessions.
* Build supporting learning resources: flyers, learning snippets, ready reckoners and post programme reinforcer material that keep learning alive after the session.
* Package content for the learning platform in SCORM and test it before release.



**Assessments and feedback:** 



* Design polls, surveys, pulse checks and feedback forms that capture learner response and inform the next round of content.
* Write knowledge checks, scenario\-based simulations and practical assessments that measure whether learning has actually landed and maintain the question banks.



**Design standard and academy support:** 



* Own the organisation's content design standard and templates and review academy content against them on request.
* Coach academy subject matter experts on how to structure and design what they teach.
* Build the materials for the Internal Facilitation Certificate alongside the trainers.



**Content governance:** 



* Keep the central content library organised, with version control and a refresh date on every item.
* Make sure content built by vendors is owned by BDO India, and that content is accessible to every learner.



  





**Experience and qualifications:**



* 8\-10 years in instructional design or learning content development, with at least 3 years running projects end to end.
* Corporate or professional services experience preferred.
* Hands on skill with authoring tools such as Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise) or Adobe Captivate, video tools such as Camtasia or Vyond, and design tools such as Canva or the Adobe suite.
* Practical experience using AI Productivity Tools and Multimedia for text, video and voice is preferable.
* Working knowledge of SCORM and how content behaves on a learning platform.
* Graduate or postgraduate degree. An instructional design certification is an advantage.



  





**About BDO:**




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It’s a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart. BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International.
 



 BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.

title: Data Migration Intern – Google Workspace
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Experience:** 
 0–1 year / Freshers
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Internship
   

  

**Duration:** 
 2–3 months
   

  

**Stipend:** 
 Paid
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented
 **Data Migration Intern** 
 to support a company\-wide migration of employee email accounts and associated data from one Google Workspace environment to another.
   

  

 The intern will work closely with the People and IT teams to ensure employee data is migrated accurately, systematically and with minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 This is a project\-based role and will involve working with employee data, Google Workspace, spreadsheets and migration trackers.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

**Email \& Data Migration**
* Support migration of employee email accounts from the existing Google Workspace/domain to the new Google Workspace/domain.
* Assist with migration of relevant mailbox data, emails, contacts, calendars and other approved Google Workspace data.
* Follow defined migration processes and checklists for each employee/account.
* Ensure data is transferred accurately and completely as per the migration plan.
* Support account setup and configuration activities as required.


**Data Validation \& Quality Checks**
* Maintain a detailed migration tracker covering all employee accounts.
* Verify migrated emails and other data against the source account.
* Identify missing, incomplete or incorrectly migrated data and coordinate resolution.
* Conduct post\-migration checks to ensure employees can access their new accounts and required data.
* Maintain clear records of completed, pending and exception cases.


**Coordination**
* Coordinate with employees to schedule migration activities and resolve basic access\-related queries.
* Work closely with the IT/Google Workspace administrator during the migration.
* Escalate technical issues or exceptions that require administrator intervention.
* Support employee communication around migration timelines, access and required actions.


**Documentation**
* Maintain migration SOPs, checklists and trackers.
* Document recurring issues and their resolutions.
* Prepare daily/weekly migration status reports.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality while handling employee and business data.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Graduate/student pursuing a degree in Computer Applications, IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related field.
* Comfortable working with Google Workspace, particularly Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets and Google Calendar.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good organisational and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable working with large volumes of data.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to follow structured processes and checklists.
* Strong sense of confidentiality and responsibility when handling employee data.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Basic understanding of Google Workspace administration.
* Exposure to email or data migration projects.
* Familiarity with CSV files, data validation and spreadsheet\-based reconciliation.
* Basic troubleshooting skills.
* Experience working with Google Admin Console would be an advantage.


 Key Success Measures
   

  

**The Intern Will Be Expected To Contribute Towards**
* Accurate and timely migration of assigned employee accounts.
* Minimal data loss or migration errors.
* Complete and accurate migration tracking.
* Timely identification and escalation of exceptions.
* Successful post\-migration validation.
* Clear documentation of the migration process.


 What You Will Learn
   

  

* Hands\-on exposure to a real\-world Google Workspace migration.
* Understanding of email, cloud data and user account migration.
* Data validation, reconciliation and project tracking.
* Cross\-functional coordination with People and IT teams.
* Exposure to managing a company\-wide technology transition.


 Important
   

  

 This role will involve access to employee and business information.
 **Confidentiality, data security and adherence to approved migration processes will be mandatory.**

title: Senior Solutions Analyst
description:
**About Quantanite \& QiQ** 




 Quantanite is a BPO company that combines human agents with proprietary AI technology. QiQ (Quantanite iQ) is our flagship AI\-powered contact centre analytics platform built on cutting\-edge agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and large language models.
 



 QiQ functions as a virtual organization of specialized AI agents that analyze customer interactions, generate operational insights, and drive measurable business outcomes. The platform processes voice, email, and chat interactions through intelligent clusters (Operations, Quality, Voice of Customer) to surface KPI insights, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations.
 



 We're looking for someone who has built agentic systems and can help design, architect, and deliver solutions for clients using this technology.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As a Senior Solutions Analyst, you'll work closely with the Solutions Architect to translate client needs into technical solutions built on agentic AI and knowledge graph architecture. You'll own the full discovery\-to\-delivery cycle for client implementations and feature development, and over time, you'll represent Solutions independently in client conversations and make real architectural decisions.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution. You'll design solutions that leverage agentic patterns, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and knowledge graphs to solve real contact centre problems. You'll also learn Quantanite's specific platform, clients, and domain so that you can eventually operate as a full Solutions Architect.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Client discovery and solutioning: Lead or co\-lead discovery calls with clients to understand their true operational problems, not just their stated requests. Propose solutions architected around agentic AI and knowledge graph patterns.
 



 ● BRD and HLD authorship: Own the creation of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and High\-Level Design (HLD) documents that translate client needs into clear, actionable specifications for engineering. Contribute real architectural thinking, not just transcription.
 



 ● Architecture and design decisions: Make calls on solution shape: which problems need agentic systems vs. simpler approaches, how to layer knowledge graphs, when to build custom orchestration vs. use existing patterns. Own the trade\-offs (cost, speed, accuracy, complexity).
 



 ● Cross\-functional coordination: Work with engineering (QLabs), product, and PMO to move projects through the BRD → HLD → TDD → Implementation → As\-built chain. Be the connective tissue between business and engineering.
 



 ● Client representation: Sit in client meetings, present solutions, answer technical questions in real time, and build confidence that Quantanite can deliver. Represent Solutions credibly as a technical leader.
 



 ● QiQ platform ownership: Develop deep working knowledge of QiQ's architecture (agentic clusters, knowledge graph layers, KPI logic, process adherence frameworks) so you can design solutions that leverage it effectively and make informed decisions about extensions.
 



 ● Learning and growth: Master Quantanite's specific clients, domain (contact centres, BPO operations), and go\-to\-market positioning.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Technical Expertise** 




**Generative AI and agentic systems** 




 ● Hands\-on experience building agentic systems
 



 ● Deep understanding of multi\-agent orchestration, agent frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph
 



 ● Proven work with RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and LLM context window management
 



 ● Experience with knowledge graphs or similar structured knowledge systems
 



 ● Can speak credibly about what's possible and what's not with current LLM technology
 



 ● Understands cost, latency, and token efficiency trade\-offs in system design
 



  





**Systems and architectural thinking** 




 ● Can decompose complex business problems into architectural solutions
 



 ● Understands when to build agentic systems vs. simpler rule\-based or API\-driven approaches
 



 ● Experience designing systems that scale (volume, complexity, cost)
 



 ● Can reason through trade\-offs and make justified design decisions
 



  





**Business and Communication** 




**Business acumen and problem translation** 




 ● Can understand client/stakeholder problems at a deep level and propose solutions that actually address root causes
 



 ● Can articulate technical solutions in business terms (impact, cost, risk, timeline)
 



 ● Comfortable with client\-facing conversations and requirements gathering
 



  





**Communication and presence** 




 ● Strong written communication: can author clear, precise technical specifications
 



 ● Strong verbal communication: can present to clients and executives without losing credibility
 



 ● Can think on your feet and handle real\-time questions in a meeting
 



 ● Naturally commands respect in rooms with non\-technical stakeholders
 



  





**Ownership and accountability** 




 ● Track record of seeing projects through from start to finish
 



 ● Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just activities
 



 ● Drives outcomes even when unclear or complex

description:
**Blue Matter Consulting** 
 is a strategy consulting firm focused exclusively on the life sciences industry. We partner with biotech startups and multinational pharmaceutical corporations to help them achieve commercial success across the lifecycle of their products, portfolios, and organizations. Our work spans new product planning, launch strategy, brand and lifecycle planning, and corporate and portfolio strategy across specialty therapeutic areas. We operate globally, with offices in the US (San Francisco, New York, Boston), Europe (London, Zurich, Netherlands), and India (Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune).
 



  





**The Role** 




 As an Associate Consultant or Consultant in our India office, you will work as an integrated member of US\- and Europe\-based project teams — directly engaging global clients, contributing to live strategy engagements, and building deliverables that shape commercial and corporate decisions.
 



 This is not a support or back\-office role. You will own meaningful workstreams, present to clients, and operate with the same expectations as your US/Europe counterparts. The role involves working partial overlap hours with US or European time zones a few days each week; work timing flexibility is provided.
 



  





**Primary Resonsibilities** 



* Onboard rapidly to new engagements — internalize objectives, scope, and timelines, and integrate with the US/Europe project team from day one
* Conduct primary and secondary research in a time\-bound manner
* Identify key insights, recommendations, opportunities, and threats to inform corporate and commercial strategies
* Create and utilize analytical tools to support strategic decision\-making
* Develop slides or memos effectively communicating results of analyses
* Prepare material for project meetings, workshops, and client presentations
* Proactively communicate progress, flag risks, and seek guidance from senior team members
* Demonstrate accountability for completion and high\-quality delivery of all assigned responsibilities
* Engage with global clients regularly (e.g., weekly updates, workshops, interim and final presentations)
* Participate in and contribute to internal initiatives including business development, knowledge management, and new capabilities development



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 We look for consultants who can hit the ground running in a project team, are scientifically trained (by experience or academic background), and demonstrate strength across four core competencies:
 


* **Critical Thinker** 
 — Able to approach a problem, understand its context and implications, and work with ambiguous information to develop creative and pragmatic solutions
* **Collaborative** 
 — Able to plan your own work, deliver on commitments to your project team, and operate effectively across time zones and cultures
* **Communicative** 
 — Able to interact transparently and concisely with internal and external stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
* **Proactive** 
 — Able to take initiative, eager to learn, receptive to feedback, and willing to take failure in stride



  





**Desired Experience and Skills** 



* Understanding of clinical trial phases and their impact on strategic decision\-making
* Demonstrated ability to integrate scientific, business, and industry knowledge in developing creative solutions for clients
* Strong analytical skills and structured, hypothesis\-driven problem\-solving
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities under tight timelines
* Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment
* Proactive and entrepreneurial in spirit
* Willingness and ability to read complex scientific material and distill key insights
* Proficiency in MS PowerPoint and Excel
* Experience using proprietary pharma databases
* Experience with pharma marketing analytics, valuation, or forecasting/modeling is a plus
* Prior demonstrated success working across time zones with international teams is a plus



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Advanced degree(s) in the biology domain — PhD, MBBS, MD, BDS, MS, BPharm/MPharm, PharmD, or MPH
* 2–3 years of prior consulting experience, OR at least 2–3 years of biopharma industry experience in roles such as portfolio planning, corporate strategy, or business development
* US/Europe life sciences industry knowledge and exposure is a plus



  





**What We Can Offer You** 



* Diverse, intellectually stimulating projects across our clients' products, portfolios, and organizations — from biotech startups to multinational pharmaceutical corporations
* Direct engagement with global clients and US/Europe project teams from day one
* Supportive environment to learn and grow, regardless of your starting skill and knowledge level
* Being empowered to drive your development, own your work, and manage your time

* Support for your developmental journey with:
* A
 **peer\-level buddy** 
 to help you navigate your way around Blue Matter and share their experiences

 **senior\-level career coach** 
 to support your overall professional development and career progression
* A
 
**senior\-level India\-based local mentor** 

 for ad hoc guidance and support

title: Proposal Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Intrelec is a long\-established provider of engineered Switchgear Panels, including MCCs, intelligent MCCs, PCCs, distribution boards, VFD and soft starter panels, as well as LV and HV busducts. For more than 47 years, the company has focused on complex, large\-scale industrial projects in sectors such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, specialty chemicals, fertilizers, mining, and cement. Most projects are delivered in partnership with leading engineering consultants, and Intrelec is approved by many prominent industry players. A key strength is its indigenously designed, type\-tested, and cost\-effective drawout assemblies, supplied for over four decades to process industries. These solutions have enabled Intrelec to be considered on par with global manufacturers and to export drawout assemblies to clients in Africa, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Proposal Engineer role at Intrelec is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Mumbai. The individual will be responsible for preparing and writing technical and commercial proposals for switchgear panels and related electrical solutions, ensuring alignment with client specifications and industry standards. Day\-to\-day tasks include reviewing tender documents, coordinating with engineering, procurement, and sales teams to gather inputs, and developing accurate cost estimates and bid documentation. The Proposal Engineer will interact with clients and consultants to clarify technical queries, support negotiations, and update proposal content based on feedback. The role also involves maintaining proposal templates, tracking bid status, and contributing to continuous improvement of proposal processes and tools.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in proposal preparation and proposal writing, including interpretation of technical specifications and tender documents.
* Solid foundation in electrical engineering, preferably with experience in switchgear panels, MCCs, PCCs, or related power distribution systems.
* Experience collaborating with sales teams, supporting pre\-sales activities, and contributing to technical presentations or client meetings.
* Exposure to procurement processes, including sourcing technical information and cost data from suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline; relevant industrial or project experience is an advantage.
* Ability to analyze technical drawings, single\-line diagrams, and equipment lists with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical information clearly.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); familiarity with ERP or bidding tools is beneficial.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple proposals and deadlines.
* Commitment to ethical, inclusive, and collaborative working practices in a diverse team environment.

**Summary**
 We are seeking a
 **Business Program \& Operations Analyst – UAT \& Implementation** 
 to support a highly visible, enterprise\-wide refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation initiative being deployed across approximately 7,530 retail locations. This large\-scale program is transforming a traditionally manual temperature\-checking and logging process through sensor technology, automated data collection, temperature alerts, and work\-order automation.
   

  

 The program is designed to provide greater visibility into refrigeration equipment performance, identify potential equipment and temperature issues earlier, reduce product loss, support compliance requirements, improve preventive and corrective maintenance processes, and generate significant operational efficiencies and cost savings.
   

  

 In this role, you will help ensure the program is successfully implemented across the store network by supporting business requirements, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), process and SOP validation, training, operational readiness, implementation quality, and go\-live activities. You will work cross\-functionally with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and other program resources to ensure solutions meet business requirements and implementations remain on schedule without compromising quality.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst or program implementation experience, with hands\-on exposure to UAT, business process testing, requirements validation, training, and implementation readiness. Experience supporting retail, facilities, store operations, or large\-scale multi\-site implementations would be especially valuable.
   

  

**Click Apply Now To Join The Chamberlain Experience.**
**What You Will Be Accountable For**
* Support the implementation and deployment of a large\-scale refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation program across approximately 7,530 retail locations.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, define, document, clarify, and validate business and operational requirements.
* Ensure new processes, system functionality, and implementations align with established business requirements and operational needs.
* Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test execution, business process validation, issue identification, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Validate system functionality, workflows, and business processes prior to deployment.
* Review and validate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure processes are accurate, practical, and aligned with business requirements.
* Identify gaps, defects, process issues, or operational risks uncovered during testing and implementation and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders through resolution.
* Support store and end\-user readiness for implementation and go\-live.
* Develop and/or support training materials, process documentation, job aids, and other resources associated with the new program.
* Facilitate or support end\-user and service\-related training to drive understanding and successful adoption of new processes.
* Support implementation and training activities associated with facilities and work\-order management processes.
* Coordinate with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, store stakeholders, and other program resources throughout the rollout.
* Help ensure installations and implementations are completed correctly and meet established business and quality standards.
* Support data validation activities to ensure information captured during implementation is accurate and complete.
* Track testing activities, implementation issues, dependencies, readiness items, and stakeholder deliverables through completion.
* Balance an aggressive implementation timeline with the need for high\-quality testing, validation, and execution.
* Support successful go\-live activities and the transition of new processes into ongoing business operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, implementation effectiveness, operational consistency, and user adoption.


**What Qualifications You Need**
* Approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst experience, including business analysis, program/project implementation, business operations, or a related area.
* Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Hands\-on experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and/or business process testing.
* Experience gathering, documenting, clarifying, and validating business requirements.
* Experience supporting implementation projects and validating that solutions meet established business and operational requirements.
* Experience identifying issues during testing or implementation and coordinating with cross\-functional stakeholders through resolution.
* Exposure to SOP/process validation, operational readiness, training, or go\-live activities strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify process gaps, risks, and inconsistencies.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple activities, deadlines, and stakeholders within a fast\-paced implementation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across business, technical, vendor, facilities, and operational teams.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining highly engaged with a cross\-functional project team.
* Ability to maintain a strong focus on both implementation timelines and quality within a highly visible program.
* Must be available to work primarily during 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST business hours, with some flexibility to start approximately one hour earlier or later.
* Ability and willingness to travel to Deerfield, IL up to approximately three times during the nine\-month engagement.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting retail, retail facilities, store operations, refrigeration, facilities operations, or other multi\-site environments.
* Experience supporting large\-scale program implementations or enterprise rollouts across multiple locations.
* Experience working with facilities or work\-order management processes and platforms.
* Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for project, testing, issue, or implementation tracking.
* Exposure to ServiceChannel or similar facilities/work\-order management systems.
* Experience with data collection tools or platforms used to support implementation and validation activities.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to organize, review, validate, and analyze implementation or operational data.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with external vendors and cross\-functional implementation teams.
* Exposure to sensor\-based monitoring, automated workflows, refrigeration/HVAC, facilities technology, or similar operational technology environments is a plus but not required.

title: Institutional Equity Division - Senior Manager, EMEA Equity Documentation Negotiator (Mumbai)
description:
EMEA Equity Documentation( ISDA) , Institutional Equity Division
   

  

 This role is in Mumbai and requires working with the EMEA Equity Documentation Group based in London. The role will require a fast\-learning, dynamic, pro\-active, and self\-motivated person to assist the team in its day\-to\-day activities.
   

  

 The current opening is for a professional within the EMEA team, based in Mumbai, with responsibility for documentation aspects of OTC derivative transactions, prime brokerage, cash and stock\-lending transactions in the EMEA region.
   

  

**Global Capital Markets:** 
 In the Global Capital Markets division, we offer Global expertise in market analysis and in advisory and capital\-raising services for corporations, institutions, and governments
   

  

 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales \& Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, strats to risk management.
   

  

 Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, continuously evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
* Manage the team of lawyers on the ground, co\-ordinate with stakeholder on team dynamics, work management and allocations. Grooming/ training of team
* Draft, negotiate and execute (including amendments to) master derivatives agreements, including but not limited to ISDA, VM CSA, IM CSA, equity swaps /options and prime brokerage related documentation.
* Review and analyze constitutional documents of the client, to establish their capacity and authority capabilities for entering derivative transactions with Morgan Stanley.
* Review and analyze capacity and authority legal opinion from external counsel and highlight issues to Risk and Legal for approvals where applicable.
* Work closely with MS internal stakeholders, to obtain approvals on deviated terms identified in negotiable agreements, with clear implication on deviated terms to enable internal stakeholders to make informed decisions.
* Handle business unit’s queries on the terms of documentation ISD handles.
* Participate in globally or locally led projects related to documentation requirements.
* Undertake tasks directly related to the coordination and lifecycle management of the clients’ agreements and act as the primary point of contact for the clients for all tasks originating from the Asia Pacific region.
* Responsible for administering and facilitating the agreement execution process; maintain and update clients’ contract database/systems; attend to day\-to\-day coordination among internal procurement and legal teams with respect to such contracts; and perform due diligence to ensure contract terms and conditions as well as information of the parties is reflected in the client’s contract database/systems.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Law graduate with relevant 8\-11 years of experience in financing/derivatives is preferred. Legal qualification is advantageous.
* Experience in team management will be preferred.
* In\-house documentation negotiation experience or paralegal experience in corporate law firm is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Prepared to speak to clients (internal and external) at all times.
* Proficiency in English is a must. Good team player with potential to lead a team.
* Solid quantitative skills and strong interest in business, economics, and law.
* Willingness and ability to provide quality service to the Firm's clients and to promote and enhance the Firm franchise.
* Willingness to work in dynamic environment and the ability to excel under pressure.
* Proficiency and interest in technology and systems development.
* Organized, pro\-active, ability to multi\-task and work efficiently, detail\-oriented, and self\-sufficient.


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to make AI smarter — and we need electrical engineers to help get there. * Organization: Alignerr

* Able to explain highly technical concepts clearly and precisely in writing
* Meticulous with mathematical equations, circuit logic, and technical documentation
* Self\-directed and comfortable working asynchronously
* No prior AI experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or AI evaluation workflows
* Familiarity with simulation tools (SPICE, MATLAB, etc.)
* Background in academic or industry research


**Why Join Us**
* Work on genuinely cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research teams
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and workload
* Freelance autonomy with the backing of a professional, global team
* Gain rare, hands\-on exposure to how advanced large language models are built and trained
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Senior Associate
description:
**About Us** 




 The Spine Foundation is a non\-profit organization dedicated to delivering free, high\-quality spine care to underprivileged communities in rural India. Founded over 25 years ago by a team of committed spine surgeons, the foundation focuses on alleviating chronic pain, limited mobility, and loss of livelihood caused by spinal disorders. Through specialized camps and outreach programs, it provides essential diagnostics, surgeries, and rehabilitation to individuals who otherwise could not afford such care. A volunteer network of leading Indian spine surgeons ensures patients receive expert treatment and a real chance to regain independence. In addition to clinical services, the foundation actively promotes spinal health awareness and preventive education to enable long\-term community well\-being.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Spine Foundation is looking for a highly committed and mature professional to work closely with Dr. Shekar Bhojraj and shadow him across his institutional, clinical, field, donor, partner and stakeholder engagements.
 



 This is a senior coordination and documentation role designed to support continuity, capture institutional knowledge, strengthen follow\-up systems and enable more structured planning around Dr. Bhojraj’s work. The role is not a conventional Executive Assistant or Research Associate position. It requires someone who can understand the purpose of TSF’s work, observe closely, document meaningfully, coordinate with multiple stakeholders and support the translation of conversations into clear action points.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Shadowing Dr. Bhojraj’s Work** 




 Accompany or closely support Dr. Bhojraj across meetings, visits, discussions, field engagements, hospital and doctor interactions, partner meetings and other institutional activities. The person will be expected to understand the context, capture key points and ensure that important conversations are not lost.
 



**2\. Documentation of Conversations and Engagements** 




 Prepare concise and useful notes from meetings, field visits, calls and stakeholder interactions. This will include recording key decisions, commitments, follow\-up points, relationship context and any strategic issues that require attention.
 



**3\. Stakeholder Coordination** 




 Liaise regularly with doctors, hospitals, field teams, partners, donors, advisors, board members, consultants and other stakeholders connected with TSF’s work. The person should be able to communicate professionally, follow up respectfully and ensure that coordination does not remain dependent only on Dr. Bhojraj.
 



**4\. Planning, Scheduling and Follow\-up** 




 Support planning and scheduling of Dr. Bhojraj’s meetings, visits and travel\-linked engagements. This includes coordinating with relevant people, preparing briefs before meetings, ensuring that background information is available, and tracking follow\-up after each engagement.
 



**5\. Institutional Memory and Continuity** 




 Help TSF build stronger institutional memory around Dr. Bhojraj’s relationships, decisions, field insights and strategic directions. The person should be able to organise information in a way that helps the wider team, leadership and advisors take work forward with clarity.
 



**6\. Support to Strategic and Operational Priorities** 




 Work closely with Dr. Bhojraj and other identified team members or consultants to support planning around institutional priorities, donor conversations, centre\-level engagements, doctor networks, camps, outreach visits and emerging opportunities.
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should have:
 



 • A Master’s degree in social work, public health, development studies, management, hospital administration, rural development or a related field.
 



 • 5\-8 years of relevant experience, preferably with exposure to both grassroots work and management\-level coordination.
 



 • Prior experience working closely with senior leadership, founders, trustees, doctors, programme heads or institutional leaders.
 



 • Strong understanding of community\-based work, health systems, rural development or social sector institutions.
 



 • Excellent documentation, note\-taking and synthesis skills.
 



 • Ability to capture not just minutes of meetings, but the larger context, relationships, concerns and follow\-up actions.
 



 • Strong coordination and interpersonal skills.
 



 • Ability to manage sensitive conversations with maturity and discretion.
 



 • Comfort with travel and accompanying leadership for field visits, stakeholder meetings and institutional engagements.
 



 • Good written and spoken communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of Marathi or other regional languages will be an added advantage.
 



 • High level of integrity, patience, humility and commitment to the cause of equitable spine care.
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 The person must be deeply aligned with TSF’s mission and should be comfortable working in a role that requires observation, listening, coordination and quiet leadership. They should be proactive without being intrusive, organised without being bureaucratic, and sensitive to the clinical, human and institutional dimensions of Dr. Bhojraj’s work.
 



 This role is suitable for someone who is passionate about public health and social impact, and who sees value in helping an institution strengthen continuity around a founder’s vision, relationships and way of working.
 



 Reporting and Working Relationship
 



 The person will work closely with Dr. Bhojraj and coordinate with identified members of the TSF team, doctors, external advisors and consultants as required. The role will require regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders and will involve both office\-based and travel\-linked responsibilities.
 



 Expected Outcome of the Role
 


* Over time, the role should help TSF ensure that Dr. Bhojraj’s work, relationships, insights and decisions are better captured, followed through and institutionalized. The position is intended to strengthen continuity, coordination and leadership support as TSF prepares for its next phase of growth and sustainability.



  





**Salary/Compensation** 




 Will commensurate based on the experience
 



  





**Additional Information:** 
 This role requires frequent travel, field visits, and close accompaniment of senior leadership, often involving long and unpredictable working hours. Considering these operational requirements, preference may be given to male candidates.

* Conduct structured product teardowns of competitor products and customer journeys to understand gaps and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.
* Research the investing ecosystem and understand customer needs, market trends, product offerings, and user behaviour.

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Strong analytical thinking. You enjoy working with numbers, breaking down problems, and finding meaningful patterns in data.
* Comfortable with SQL. You can write basic queries using SELECT, filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data. Deep SQL expertise is not required.
* Sharp product sense and genuine curiosity about how users interact with financial products.
* Strong ownership. You take a problem and run with it end to end, without needing constant hand\-holding.

* Genuine interest in fintech, investing, or financial products is a strong plus.
* Strong written communication. You can take a messy problem or a set of data and turn it into a clear, structured insight.
* High comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias for action.


 Why This Role Rocks
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast\-moving
 **Product team** 
 , working on real product problems across the investing journey, with exposure to the
 **Mutual Funds and Advisory** 
 space.
   

  

 You’ll get hands\-on exposure to
 **product management, SQL, product analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and data\-driven decision\-making** 
 while working on real problems and seeing how your insights translate into product improvements.
   

  

 You’ll learn how to connect
 **data → insights → product decisions** 
 and get direct exposure to the full product lifecycle in a fast\-moving fintech environment.

title: Content & UI Specialist
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll proactively partner with stakeholders to develop, manage, and maintain digital content across CMS platforms, ensuring quality, accuracy, and consistency at every stage.
* You'll lead the creation and management of pages supporting product, feature, and campaign launches.
* You'll establish, advocate for, and enforce content standards and best practices across CMS platforms.
* You'll manage site authors by overseeing access permissions, governance processes, and CMS training initiatives.
* You'll conduct regular site audits to identify broken links, outdated content, and UX issues while driving continuous content improvements.
* You'll optimise web pages for usability, accessibility, and search engine optimisation (SEO).
* You'll collaborate with UX/UI designers across multiple geographies and time zones to implement intuitive interfaces, improve user journeys, and enhance overall site usability.
* You'll partner with developers, product teams, and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into polished, user\-friendly digital experiences.
* You'll design and implement features and workflows that improve efficiency in content management processes.
* You'll ensure all digital experiences meet responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll build feasibility analyses and proof\-of\-concept (POC) solutions for optimisation initiatives using ZCM's standard CMS component set.
* You'll plan, build, and execute A/B and multivariate tests using ZCM's test\-and\-learn toolset.
* You'll validate optimisation rules and audience segment configurations to ensure accurate test delivery.
* You'll analyse test results and convert insights into actionable recommendations, effectively communicating outcomes to stakeholders across locations.
* You'll lead UAT and QA processes to ensure accurate, high\-performing, and compliant digital experiences across web and app touchpoints.
* You'll validate content, functionality, device responsiveness, and WCAG compliance across partner and owned digital properties.
* You'll coordinate QA activities across distributed teams to ensure comprehensive testing and smooth go\-live execution.
* You'll act as the subject\-matter expert on ZCM's CMS, optimisation toolset, and digital platforms, providing first\-level support to the Rapid Learning Lab team globally.
* You'll document requirements for CMS component enhancements and communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* You'll demonstrate strong asynchronous communication practices, keeping remote and onshore stakeholders informed, engaged, and unblocked between scheduled touchpoints.
* You'll work closely with Content, UX Design, Engineering, and broader business teams to deliver cohesive, high\-quality digital outcomes.
* You'll align Rapid Learning Lab and travel partner requirements to maximise technology capabilities, optimise user experiences, and drive sales performance.
* You'll write and debug CSS to create high\-quality web experiences, including resolving specificity and cascade conflicts, leveraging CSS custom properties, and translating design mockups into responsive, production\-ready web pages.
* You'll apply modern CSS layout techniques, including Flexbox and CSS Grid, to build responsive interfaces that provide an optimal experience across devices and screen sizes.
* You'll use browser Developer Tools to inspect, troubleshoot, and resolve styling, layout, and markup issues in live environments.
* You'll utilise vanilla JavaScript for DOM manipulation, including element selection, content updates, class management, and basic interactive functionality.
* You'll create, update, and manage website content using Web Content Management Systems (CMS), ensuring accurate and engaging digital experiences.
* You'll build and manage A/B and multivariate tests on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) websites using Adobe Target and similar experimentation platforms to optimise user experience and business outcomes.
* You'll apply front\-end development skills to implement, customise, and support website enhancements, experiments, and digital initiatives.
* You'll maintain a strong understanding of website architecture, functionality, and best practices to support effective digital delivery.
* You'll ensure websites meet WCAG and ADA accessibility standards by identifying, addressing, and preventing common accessibility issues.
* You'll apply SEO best practices, ensuring websites are optimised for search engine visibility, performance, and discoverability.
* You'll design and develop responsive web experiences that follow industry best practices and deliver consistent functionality across a range of devices and screen sizes.
* You'll implement and validate web analytics and advertising tracking tags using tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, and related marketing technologies to support measurement and optimisation activities.
* You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure tracking, experimentation, accessibility, SEO, and front\-end development requirements are effectively delivered and maintained.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll bring a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Digital Marketing, Web Design, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field.
* You'll have 18 months or more of hands\-on, business\-side experience managing content within a CMS for a public\-facing website.
* You'll demonstrate experience working within offshore, distributed, or globally dispersed teams, successfully managing deliverables and communications across multiple time zones.
* You'll have hands\-on experience with one or more enterprise CMS platforms, such as Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Tridion, or Ektron.
* You'll possess experience using multivariate and A/B testing tools and methodologies, including platforms such as Adobe Target, Optimizely, Google Optimize, or similar solutions.
* You'll have a solid technical understanding of HTML, CSS, and web publishing principles.
* You'll demonstrate a strong understanding of content optimisation, technical SEO principles, and digital best practices.
* You'll have proven experience creating and managing web pages designed for a global audience.
* You'll possess strong knowledge of responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll have experience leading or supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) processes for digital products.
* You'll stand out with experience using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* You'll bring knowledge of additional Adobe Digital Marketing tools, such as Adobe Target and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
* You'll have familiarity with digital environments within the travel or insurance industries.
* You'll have exposure to analytics and reporting tools that support optimisation and test performance analysis.
* You'll be exceptionally detail\-oriented, with outstanding proofreading skills and a commitment to content accuracy and test quality.
* You'll be a clear and proactive communicator who keeps remote and onshore stakeholders informed, aligned, and engaged.
* You'll work confidently and independently, managing priorities across multiple time zones with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* You'll thrive in a fast\-paced environment, seamlessly switching between priorities while consistently meeting deadlines without compromising quality.
* You'll be self\-motivated, responsive, and committed to delivering high\-quality digital experiences regardless of team location.
* You'll be highly collaborative and team\-oriented, recognising that exceptional digital experiences are built through strong global partnerships.
* You'll be naturally curious and improvement\-focused, constantly seeking opportunities to enhance digital experiences and outcomes.


**So, why choose us?**
 We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.
   

  

 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

 Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

 Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**
* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.


 Apply today and let’s go great places together!

title: Bid Specialist

description:

* Familiarity with MS Excel, Word, and documentation processes
* Good understanding of technical specifications (preferred for engineering products)

* High attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

* Experience in e\-procurement platforms apart from GeM
* Knowledge of government tendering norms
* Analytical and negotiation skills



  





**Qualifications** 



* Demonstrated expertise in bid\-focused activities such as Bid Preparation and Bid Writing, with the ability to produce clear, accurate, and persuasive documentation.
* Experience in Bid Management and Proposal Management, including coordinating cross\-functional inputs and managing multiple bids within defined timelines.
* Strong understanding of Bid Processes, with capability to implement and refine structured workflows, checklists, and compliance reviews.

title: Associate Training Manager
description:

 Customer Experience

* Develop and implement standardized training workflows to ensure consistency across geographies and business units.

* Evaluate, implement, and manage LMS, LCMS, AI\-powered tools, automation frameworks, and content delivery platforms to improve training efficiency.

* Ensure seamless integration of training platforms with HR systems, CRM, knowledge management tools, and other business systems.
* Drive adoption of AI\-based content tagging, auto\-translation, and metadata standardization for faster content retrieval and reusability.

* Partner with Instructional Designers, SMEs, and content teams to identify process inefficiencies and implement structured workflows that improve productivity.
